packTitle: 2025年6月六级第1–3套全（仔细阅读A/B + 长篇阅读）

readingA.title: Passage One · 美国学生缺勤危机与教育政策反思（46–50题）
readingA.sourceCitation: 出处：The Conversation ("Why student absences aren't the real problem in America's 'attendance crisis'")
readingA.sourceLabel: 说客英语 2025年6月六级第1套 Section C

sentences.en: Nationally, one in six children miss 15 or more days of school in a year.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，每六名儿童中就有一人一年缺课 15 天或以上。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:46:trap-46-b:46B 挖坑:Education officials have deplored all this missed instruction.}}
sentences.zh: 教育官员们对如此之多的课堂教学缺失深表痛惜。

sentences.en: These chronically absent students suffer academically because of all the classroom instruction they miss out on.
sentences.zh: 这些长期缺勤的学生因错过大量课堂教学而在学业上受损。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:46:trap-46-a:46A 挖坑:In 2015, the U.S. secretary of education responded to this crisis, urging communities to support every student to attend every day and be successful in school.}}
sentences.zh: 2015 年，美国教育部长对这一危机作出回应，敦促各社区支持每一名学生每天出勤并在校取得成功。

sentences.en: {{HIT:46:hit-46:46C 正解依据:His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement.}}
sentences.zh: 他在公开信中称，无论何种原因——无论请假还是无故旷课——一年缺课 10% 是学业成绩低下的主要原因。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:46:trap-46-d:46D 挖坑:Worrying about whether children attend school makes sense.}} After all, if students don't show up, teachers can't teach them.
sentences.zh: 担心孩子是否上学合情合理。毕竟，如果学生不来上课，老师就无法教他们。

sentence.tag: P2 长难句拆解 · 宾语从句+破折号插入语（Q46 定位）

chunks.text: His open letter stated that
missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason
—excused or unexcused—
is a primary cause of low academic achievement.

sentence.analysis: 破折号中的 excused or unexcused 做补充说明，先跳过即可一眼看清核心主干：missing 10% of school days ... is a primary cause of low academic achievement，直接对应 46C mainly attributed to school absences。

sentences.en: But what if America's attendance crisis is about much more than students missing class?
sentences.zh: 但如果美国的出勤危机远不止学生缺课这么简单呢？

sentences.en: What if, instead, it is a reflection of family and community crises these students face—such as being ejected from the family apartment, fearing for their safety in their neighborhood or suffering an illness?
sentences.zh: 相反，如果它反映的是这些学生所面临的家庭与社区危机——比如被赶出家住的公寓、担心社区安全或身患疾病——那又该如何看待？

sentences.en: As social scientists we investigated how excused and unexcused absences relate to children's academic achievement.
sentences.zh: 作为社会科学家，我们研究了请假缺勤和无故旷课分别如何与儿童的学业成绩相关联。

sentences.en: {{HIT:47:hit-47:47A 正解依据:We find that absences excused by a parent do little to harm children's learning.}}
sentences.zh: 我们发现，经家长请假的缺勤几乎不会损害孩子的学习。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:47:trap-47-c:47C 挖坑:In fact, children with no unexcused absences—but 15 to 18 excused absences—have test scores equal to their peers who have no absences.}}
sentences.zh: 事实上，没有无故旷课、但有 15 到 18 天请假缺勤的孩子，其考试成绩与全勤同龄人相当。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:47:trap-47-bd:47B/D 挖坑:Meanwhile, the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none.}}
sentences.zh: 与此同时，哪怕只有一天无故旷课的普通孩子，其学业表现也比从未无故旷课的同龄人差得多。

sentence.tag: P4 长难句拆解 · 对比数据句（Q47 排雷关键）

chunks.text: children with no unexcused absences
—but 15 to 18 excused absences—
have test scores equal to their peers
who have no absences.

sentence.analysis: 注意 equal to 是“相当/持平”，而不是 47C 偷换的“更好（better）”；而前一句 do little to harm 才是 47A have little impact on 的原句同义改写。

sentences.en: {{HIT:48:hit-48:48B 正解依据:We believe unexcused absence is a strong signal of the many challenges children and families face, including economic and medical hardships.}}
sentences.zh: 我们认为，无故旷课是儿童及其家庭面临诸多挑战（包括经济和医疗困难）的强烈信号。

sentences.en: Unexcused absences can be a powerful signal of how those out-of-school challenges affect children's academic progress.
sentences.zh: 无故旷课可以强有力地反映出这些校外挑战是如何影响孩子的学业进步的。

sentences.en: Our evidence suggests unexcused absences are problematic, but for a different reason than people often think.
sentences.zh: 我们的证据表明无故旷课确实存在问题，但原因与人们通常认为的不同。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:48:trap-48-d:48D 挖坑:Absence from school, and especially unexcused absence, matters mainly as a signal of many crises children and their families may be facing.}}
sentences.zh: 缺课——尤其是无故旷课——的重要性主要在于它是儿童及其家庭当前可能面临诸多危机的信号。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:48:trap-48-a:48A 挖坑:It matters less as a cause of lower student achievement due to missed instruction.}}
sentences.zh: 它作为因错过课堂教学而导致学业成绩下降的原因，其重要性反而较小。

sentences.en: How we choose to think of school absences matters for educational policy.
sentences.zh: 我们选择如何看待学生缺勤，对教育政策的制定至关重要。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:49:trap-49-c:49C 挖坑:School attendance policies typically hold schools and families accountable for the days children miss, regardless of whether they were excused or unexcused absences.}}
sentences.zh: 学校出勤政策通常要求学校和家庭对孩子的缺勤天数负责，而不管这些缺勤是请假还是无故旷课。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:49:trap-49-ad:49A/D 挖坑:These policies assume that missing school for any reason harms children academically because they are missing classroom instruction.}}
sentences.zh: 这些政策假定，无论出于何种原因缺课都会因错过课堂教学而在学业上损害孩子。

sentences.en: {{HIT:49:hit-49:49B 正解依据:They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences.}} We find neither to be the case.
sentences.zh: 它们还假定学校能够通过减少学生缺勤来进行有效干预。但我们发现这两种假设都不成立。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:50:trap-50-d:50D 挖坑:As a result, these attendance policies end up disproportionately punishing families dealing with out-of-school crises in their lives and pressuring schools who serve them to get students to school more often.}}
sentences.zh: 结果，这些出勤政策最终不成比例地惩罚了正在应对校外生活危机的家庭，并向服务这些家庭的学校施压，要求它们让学生更频繁地上学。

sentences.en: {{HIT:50:hit-50:50C 正解依据:We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most.}}
sentences.zh: 相反，我们建议将无故旷课作为一个信号，把资源引导给最需要帮助的儿童和家庭。

sentence.tag: P9 长难句拆解 · 建议收束句（Q50 定位）

chunks.text: We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal
to channel resources to the children and families
who need them most.

sentence.analysis: channel resources to...（把资源引导/输送给……）在 50C 中精准替换为 Directing resources to helping needy children。

questions.qTypeTip: 问某人的公开信/发言内容（say in his open letter），直接扫人名或 open letter 定位原句，切勿与前一句“背景呼吁”或前一段“其他官员态度”混为一谈。
questions.stem: What does the U.S. secretary of education say in his open letter?
questions.stemZh: 美国教育部长在他的公开信中说了什么？
questions.step1Tip: 用 open letter 锁定 P2 第 3 句：stated that missing 10% of school days ... is a primary cause of low academic achievement。

options.text: It is of vital importance to respond promptly to the school absence crisis.
options.zh: 及时应对学生缺勤危机至关重要。
options.reason: 拼凑 P2 第 2 句 responded to this crisis，但这不是公开信里的具体论断。

options.text: The academic performance of chronically absent students is deplorable.
options.zh: 长期缺勤学生的学业表现令人痛惜。
options.reason: deplored 出自 P1 教育官员对缺课的态度，并非教育部长公开信内容，且对象偷换为学业表现。

options.text: Low academic achievement is mainly attributed to school absences.
options.zh: 学业成绩低下主要归因于缺课。
options.reason: 精准改写 P2 第 3 句 missing 10% of school days ... is a primary cause of low academic achievement。

options.text: The effect of school absences on American education is worrisome.
options.zh: 缺课对美国教育的影响令人担忧。
options.reason: Worrying about... makes sense 是作者在公开信之后的评论，并非公开信所言。

questions.locQuote: His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement.
questions.synonymFrom: is a primary cause of low academic achievement
questions.synonymTo: Low academic achievement is mainly attributed to

questions.qTypeTip: 问研究发现（find），锁定 P4 的 We find that...，特别小心比较级偷换（equal to ≠ better）。
questions.stem: What do the authors find about school absences?
questions.stemZh: 关于学生缺勤，作者们发现了什么？
questions.step1Tip: 直接找 P4 的 We find that...，注意区分 excused（请假）与 unexcused（无故旷课）的截然不同结论。

options.text: Excused school absences have little impact on children's learning.
options.zh: 请假缺勤对孩子的学习几乎没有影响。
options.reason: 精准对应 P4 第 2 句 absences excused by a parent do little to harm children's learning。

options.text: There is little difference between unexcused and excused absences.
options.zh: 无故旷课与请假缺勤之间几乎没有差别。
options.reason: 原文明确指出两者差别极大：哪怕一次无故旷课也会导致学业差得多。

options.text: Excused absences lead to comparatively better school performance.
options.zh: 请假缺勤会带来相对更好的学业表现。
options.reason: 原文说的是成绩与全勤同龄人相当（equal to），而非更好（better）。

options.text: Unexcused absences are a big challenge to both schools and families.
options.zh: 无故旷课对学校和家庭都是巨大挑战。
options.reason: 原文 P5 指出无故旷课是家庭面临挑战的“信号”，而非它本身是对学校和家庭的挑战。

questions.locQuote: We find that absences excused by a parent do little to harm children's learning.
questions.synonymFrom: do little to harm children's learning
questions.synonymTo: have little impact on children's learning

questions.qTypeTip: 题干出现 believe，直接回原文找 We believe（P5 首句），并警惕选项里的时态陷阱（正在面临 vs 未来可能面临）。
questions.stem: What do the authors believe concerning unexcused school absences?
questions.stemZh: 关于无故旷课，作者们持什么观点？
questions.step1Tip: 定位 P5 首句 We believe unexcused absence is a strong signal of the many challenges...，同时用 P6 排除 A 和 D。

options.text: They are likely to cause a decrease in students' academic achievements due to missed instruction.
options.zh: 它们很可能因错过课堂教学而导致学生学业成绩下降。
options.reason: P6 末句明确指出它作为因错过教学致成绩下降的原因“重要性较小（matters less）”。

options.text: They point directly to many of the out-of-school challenges confronting children and their families.
options.zh: 它们直接指向儿童及其家庭面临的诸多校外挑战。
options.reason: 精准改写 P5 is a strong signal of the many challenges children and families face 及 out-of-school challenges。

options.text: They are matters the American government typically ignores when formulating educational policies.
options.zh: 它们是美国政府在制定教育政策时通常忽视的问题。
options.reason: 原文说政策一刀切问责，并未说政府忽视无故旷课。

options.text: They give a clear signal to children and their families of the crises they are likely to face in the future.
options.zh: 它们向儿童和家庭发出未来可能面临危机的明确信号。
options.reason: 原文是“正在面临（may be facing）”的危机信号，而非“未来（in the future）”，且信号是给学校/政策方的。

questions.locQuote: We believe unexcused absence is a strong signal of the many challenges children and families face, including economic and medical hardships.
questions.synonymFrom: a strong signal of the many challenges ... out-of-school challenges
questions.synonymTo: point directly to many of the out-of-school challenges confronting

questions.qTypeTip: 题干问 assumption underlying education policies，精准回原文扫 assume（P8 出现两次 assume！），逐一比对两个假设。
questions.stem: What is the assumption underlying education policies in the U.S.?
questions.stemZh: 美国教育政策背后的假设是什么？
questions.step1Tip: 锁定 P8 两个 assume 句：假设①任何原因缺课都因错过教学伤学业；假设②学校能通过减少缺勤有效干预。

options.text: Children's academic performance depends on reducing the number of absences.
options.zh: 孩子的学业表现取决于减少缺勤次数。
options.reason: 原文说缺课会损害学业，并非学业表现完全“取决于（depends on）”减少缺勤。

options.text: Schools can boost children's academic performance by effective intervention.
options.zh: 学校可以通过有效干预提升孩子的学业表现。
options.reason: 精准对应 P8 第 2 句 They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences。

options.text: Schools as well as families should be held responsible for out-of-school crises.
options.zh: 学校和家庭都应对校外危机负责。
options.reason: P7 说的是对“缺勤天数（the days children miss）”负责，不是对“校外危机”负责。

options.text: Children's academic performance is closely related to the quality of instruction.
options.zh: 孩子的学业表现与教学质量密切相关。
options.reason: 原文说的是错过课堂教学（missing classroom instruction），未讨论“教学质量（quality）”。

questions.locQuote: They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences.
questions.synonymFrom: schools will be able to effectively intervene
questions.synonymTo: Schools can boost children's academic performance by effective intervention

questions.qTypeTip: 末题问作者建议（suggest doing），90% 落在文章最后一段的 instead / suggest / recommend 句。
questions.stem: What do the authors suggest doing regarding school absences?
questions.stemZh: 关于学生缺勤，作者们建议怎么做？
questions.step1Tip: 直接扫 P9 末句 We instead suggest...，抓住核心动词短语 channel resources to。

options.text: Identifying their underlying causes.
options.zh: 找出缺勤背后的根本原因。
options.reason: 原文建议比“识别原因”更进一步，明确要求把无故旷课当作信号去定向输送资源。

options.text: Reframing school attendance policies.
options.zh: 重构学校出勤政策。
options.reason: P9 末句并未笼统提“重构政策”，而是给出了具体的资源分配方案。

options.text: Directing resources to helping needy children.
options.zh: 将资源定向用于帮助有需要的孩子。
options.reason: 精准改写 P9 末句 channel resources to the children and families who need them most。

options.text: Pressuring schools to reduce unexcused ones.
options.zh: 向学校施压以减少无故旷课。
options.reason: P9 首句正是批评现行政策“向学校施压”，与作者建议完全相反。

questions.locQuote: We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most.
questions.synonymFrom: channel resources to the children and families who need them most
questions.synonymTo: Directing resources to helping needy children

readingB.title: Passage Two · “追随热爱”原则的社会学反思（51–55题）
readingB.sourceCitation: 出处：Erin A. Cech, The Trouble with Passion (UC Press)
readingB.sourceLabel: UC Press Blog / 说客英语 2025年6月第1套 Passage 2

sentences.en: After earning a bachelor's degree, I was determined to do what I love.
sentences.zh: 拿到本科学位后，我下定决心要做自己热爱的事。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:51:trap-51-a:51A 挖坑:I headed straight to graduate school to investigate the social problems that fascinated me.}}
sentences.zh: 我直接去读研，研究令我着迷的社会问题。

sentences.en: {{HIT:51:hit-51:51D 正解依据:For almost a decade, I told everyone I encountered that they should do the same. "Follow your passion," I counseled. "You can figure out the employment stuff later."}}
sentences.zh: 近十年来，我告诉遇见的每一个人都应该这样做。“追随你的热爱，”我建议道，“就业的事以后再慢慢想。”

sentences.en: {{TRAP:51:trap-51-b:51B 挖坑:It wasn't until I began to research this widely accepted career advice that I understood how problematic it really was.}}
sentences.zh: 直到我开始研究这条广为接受的职业建议，我才明白它其实有多大问题。

sentence.tag: P1 长难句拆解 · 强调句型 It wasn't until... that...（全文转折）

chunks.text: It wasn't until I began to research this widely accepted career advice
that I understood how problematic it really was.

sentence.analysis: It wasn't until... that... 译为“直到……才……”，引出作者从推崇“追随热爱”到发现其弊端的态度大转折。

sentences.en: As a sociologist, I interviewed college students and professional workers to learn what it really meant to pursue their dreams, which I will refer to here as the passion principle.
sentences.zh: 作为一名社会学家，我采访了大学生和职场人士，以了解追逐梦想究竟意味着什么——我在这里将其称为“热爱原则”。

sentences.en: {{HIT:52:hit-52:52A 正解依据:I was stunned by what I found out about this principle in the research for my new book.}}
sentences.zh: 我在为新书做研究时关于这一原则所发现的结果令我震惊。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:52:trap-52-d:52D 挖坑:Surveys show the American public has long held the passion principle in high regard as a career decision-making priority. And its popularity is even stronger among those facing job instability.}}
sentences.zh: 调查显示，美国公众长期以来高度推崇将“热爱原则”作为职业决策的首要标准，而且在面临就业不稳定的人群中它更受欢迎。

sentences.en: Advocates of the passion principle found it compelling because they believed that following one's passion can provide workers with both the motivation necessary to work hard and a place to find fulfillment.
sentences.zh: “热爱原则”的拥护者觉得它很有说服力，因为他们相信追随热爱既能给劳动者提供努力工作的动力，又能提供获得成就感的空间。

sentences.en: {{HIT:52:hit-52b:52A 延伸依据:Yet, what I found is that following one's passion does not necessarily lead to fulfillment, but is one of the most powerful cultural forces perpetuating overwork.}}
sentences.zh: 然而，我发现追随热爱并不一定带来成就感，反而成了使过度劳累长期化的最强大文化力量之一。

sentences.en: I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.
sentences.zh: 我还发现，宣扬追随热爱会助长社会不平等，因为并非每个人都拥有同等经济资源，能够从容地去追逐热爱。

sentence.tag: P3 长难句拆解 · 主语从句+原因状语（核心论点句）

chunks.text: I also found that
promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities
due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources
to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.

sentence.analysis: perpetuate 是六级超高频词，意为“使永久化、助长延续”，直接对应 54C 中的 is likely to persist。

sentences.en: While the passion principle is broadly popular, not everyone has the necessary resources to turn their passion into a stable, good-paying job.
sentences.zh: 尽管“热爱原则”广受欢迎，但并非每个人都有必要资源把热爱转化为一份稳定且高薪的工作。

sentences.en: {{HIT:53:hit-53:53D 正解依据:Passion-seekers from wealthy families are better able to wait until a job they are passionate about comes along without worrying about student loans in the meantime.}}
sentences.zh: 出身富裕家庭的热爱追逐者更有能力等待心仪工作的出现，而在此期间不必担心助学贷款。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:53:trap-53-a:53A 挖坑:They are also better situated to take unpaid internships to get their foot in the door while their parents pay their rent.}}
sentences.zh: 在父母帮付房租的情况下，他们也更有条件接受无薪实习以敲开行业大门。

sentences.en: {{HIT:53:hit-53b:53D 补充依据:And they often have access to parents' social networks to help them find jobs.}}
sentences.zh: 而且他们往往能借助父母的社交人脉帮自己找工作。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:54:trap-54-a:54A 挖坑:Surveys revealed that working-class and first-generation college graduates, regardless of their career field, are more likely than their wealthier peers to end up in low-paying unskilled jobs when they pursue their passion.}}
sentences.zh: 调查显示，无论从事哪个行业，工薪阶层和家族第一代大学毕业生在追随热爱时，都比富裕同龄人更容易最终落入低薪非技术岗位。

sentences.en: {{HIT:54:hit-54:54C 正解依据:Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.}}
sentences.zh: 高校、职场和职业顾问如果不先拉平竞争环境，就向所有人宣扬“追随热爱”的道路，只会助长求职者之间的社会经济不平等。

sentence.tag: P4 长难句拆解 · 嵌套定语从句+插入短语（Q54 定位）

chunks.text: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors
who promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone,
without leveling the playing field,
help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.

sentence.analysis: level the playing field 是地道习语，意为“创造公平的竞争环境”。剥离中间修饰成分后，主干清晰指向 54C。

sentences.en: It's not just well-off passion-seekers who benefit from the passion principle. Employers of passionate workers do, too.
sentences.zh: 从“热爱原则”中获益的不仅仅是家境优渥的热爱追逐者，雇佣满怀热忱员工的雇主同样获益。

sentences.en: {{HIT:55:hit-55:55B 正解依据:Potential employers showed greater interest in passionate applicants in part because they believed the applicants would work hard at their jobs without expecting an increase in pay.}}
sentences.zh: 潜在雇主对充满热情的求职者表现出更大兴趣，部分原因在于他们相信这些求职者会努力工作而不指望加薪。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:55:trap-55-a:55A 挖坑:They even sacrifice a good salary, job stability and leisure time to work in a job they love.}}
sentences.zh: 他们甚至愿意牺牲丰厚的薪水、工作稳定性和闲暇时间，只为从事一份自己热爱的工作。

questions.qTypeTip: 用时间短语 for almost a decade 精准定位 P1 第 3 句，注意“追随热爱”与高阶词 zealous for（热衷于）的同义替换。
questions.stem: What did the author advise people do for almost a decade?
questions.stemZh: 近十年来，作者一直建议人们做什么？
questions.step1Tip: 定位 P1 第 3 句 For almost a decade, I told everyone ... do the same. "Follow your passion,"，对应前句 do what I love。

options.text: Figure out what is the most fascinating job.
options.zh: 弄清楚什么是最迷人的工作。
options.reason: 原文说的是先追随热爱、就业的事以后再 figure out，并未建议找“最迷人的工作”。

options.text: Follow widely accepted career counsel.
options.zh: 遵循广为接受的职业建议。
options.reason: widely accepted career advice 是作者后来反思时对“追随热爱”的定性，不是他给别人的建议内容。

options.text: Pursue their careers with passion.
options.zh: 带着热情去追求自己的事业。
options.reason: 原文建议的是“做自己热爱的事（do what I love / follow your passion）”，而非“对现有职业投入热情”。

options.text: Do whatever they are zealous for.
options.zh: 做任何他们热衷的事情。
options.reason: be zealous for = love / have passion for，精准替换 do what I love 与 Follow your passion。

questions.locQuote: For almost a decade, I told everyone I encountered that they should do the same. "Follow your passion," I counseled.
questions.synonymFrom: do what I love / Follow your passion
questions.synonymTo: Do whatever they are zealous for

questions.qTypeLabel: 态度感受题 · 研究震惊
questions.qTypeTip: 锁定情绪动词 stunned（震惊的）并顺读 P3 的核心发现（what I found is...）。注：本题机构答案存在小分歧（说客/Scribd 选 A，新东方选 D），从 P2–P3 逻辑主线看作者真正震惊的是该原则导致的过度劳累与不平等后果，A 更贴合文意。
questions.stem: How did the author feel about the passion principle through his research?
questions.stemZh: 通过研究，作者对“热爱原则”有何感受？
questions.step1Tip: 锁定 P2 末句 I was stunned by what I found out about this principle，再看 P3 两处 what I found 揭示的负面后果。

options.text: He was astonished by its consequences.
options.zh: 他对其造成的后果感到震惊。
options.reason: astonished = stunned；P3 两处 what I found 揭示该原则导致过度劳累与社会不平等两大后果（注：个别机构给 D，但 P3 流行度只是转折前铺垫，A 更契合全文重心）。

options.text: He was further convinced of its soundness.
options.zh: 他更加确信其合理性。
options.reason: 作者发现该原则极具问题（problematic），与 convinced of its soundness 相反。

options.text: He was actually right to follow it through.
options.zh: 他坚持追随它其实是正确的。
options.reason: 作者明确反思了过去的盲目推崇，并非认为自己是对的。

options.text: He was struck by its broad popularity.
options.zh: 他对其广泛流行感到惊讶。
options.reason: P3 首句提流行度只是 Yet 转折前的背景铺垫，并非作者 stunned 的核心发现。

questions.locQuote: I was stunned by what I found out about this principle in the research for my new book. ... Yet, what I found is that following one's passion ... is one of the most powerful cultural forces perpetuating overwork.
questions.synonymFrom: stunned by what I found out (overwork & inequalities)
questions.synonymTo: astonished by its consequences

questions.qTypeTip: 用 turn their passion into a stable, good-paying job 定位 P4 首句，紧跟其后的三个并列例子（富家不愁贷款、父母付房租、父母社交人脉）共同归纳出正确答案。
questions.stem: What is important to turning one's passion into a stable, good-paying job?
questions.stemZh: 将热爱转化为稳定高薪的工作，什么因素至关重要？
questions.step1Tip: 回 P4 首句后连读三句：wealthy families / parents pay their rent（资金支持）+ parents' social networks（人脉资源）。

options.text: Willingness to take unpaid internships and low-paying jobs.
options.zh: 愿意接受无薪实习和低薪工作。
options.reason: 富裕家庭学生之所以能接无薪实习，前提是父母帮付房租，不是单靠“意愿”。

options.text: Full academic preparedness and sound career counseling.
options.zh: 充分的学术准备和合理的职业指导。
options.reason: 原文未提学术准备，且批评职业顾问不顾现实条件盲目鼓吹追随热爱。

options.text: Hard work and sacrifice of leisure time.
options.zh: 努力工作和牺牲闲暇时间。
options.reason: 这是 P5 雇主压榨热情员工的表现，而非转化为稳定高薪工作的关键条件。

options.text: Financial backing and social connections.
options.zh: 经济支持与社会关系人脉。
options.reason: 精准概括 P4 的 economic resources / wealthy families / parents pay their rent（经济支持）与 parents' social networks（社会关系）。

questions.locQuote: Passion-seekers from wealthy families are better able to wait... while their parents pay their rent. And they often have access to parents' social networks to help them find jobs.
questions.synonymFrom: wealthy families / parents pay their rent + parents' social networks
questions.synonymTo: Financial backing and social connections

questions.qTypeTip: 锁定 P4 末句 promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone，抓取谓语 perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities 的同义改写。
questions.stem: What happens when everyone is encouraged to follow their passion?
questions.stemZh: 当所有人都被鼓励去追随热爱时，会发生什么？
questions.step1Tip: 定位 P4 末句 promote ... for everyone ... help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities。

options.text: Many more career aspirants end up unemployed.
options.zh: 更多求职者最终失业。
options.reason: 原文说的是工薪阶层毕业生更容易落入“低薪非技术工作（low-paying unskilled jobs）”，而非“失业”。

options.text: People are less concerned with socioeconomic inequality
options.zh: 人们不再那么关心社会经济不平等。
options.reason: 原文说的是助长不平等延续，未说人们“不关心”它。

options.text: Socioeconomic inequality is likely to persist.
options.zh: 社会经济不平等很可能会持续存在。
options.reason: persist 精准替换 perpetuate（使长期存在/延续）。

options.text: Career counselors are going to lose credibility.
options.zh: 职业顾问将失去公信力。
options.reason: 原文虽点名了 career counselors，但从未提及他们会失去公信力。

questions.locQuote: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.
questions.synonymFrom: help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities
questions.synonymTo: Socioeconomic inequality is likely to persist

questions.qTypeTip: 锁定 P5 的 Employers of passionate workers，理解雇主之所以偏爱热情求职者，是因为可以低成本获取超额付出（exploit）。
questions.stem: What does the author say about employers of passionate workers?
questions.stemZh: 关于雇佣满怀热情员工的雇主，作者说了什么？
questions.step1Tip: 通读 P5 三句：雇主也从热爱原则中获益（benefit）→ 认为热情员工努力工作且不求加薪，甚至牺牲高薪、稳定性和闲暇。

options.text: They provide these workers with job stability and a good salary.
options.zh: 他们为这些员工提供工作稳定性和丰厚薪水。
options.reason: 原文是员工为了热爱“牺牲（sacrifice）”了高薪与稳定，并非雇主主动提供。

options.text: They exploit these workers' passion to benefit themselves.
options.zh: 他们利用这些员工的热情来为自己谋利。
options.reason: 高度概括 P5 全段：雇主同样从中获益（benefit），因为热情员工努力干活还不求加薪。

options.text: They level the playing field for these workers to reach their goals.
options.zh: 他们为这些员工创造公平的竞争环境以实现目标。
options.reason: level the playing field 出自 P4，且原文指责职场并未做到这一点。

options.text: They encourage these workers to realize their aspirations.
options.zh: 他们鼓励这些员工实现抱负。
options.reason: 作者持批判态度，指出雇主看重的是低成本压榨，而非真心鼓励实现抱负。

questions.locQuote: Employers of passionate workers do, too. Potential employers showed greater interest in passionate applicants in part because they believed the applicants would work hard at their jobs without expecting an increase in pay.
questions.synonymFrom: benefit from ... work hard without expecting an increase in pay
questions.synonymTo: exploit these workers' passion to benefit themselves

longReading.title: Why Your Library Is the Most Important Place in Town
longReading.titleZh: 为什么图书馆是城镇中最重要的地方
longReading.wordCount: 约 1,090 词 · A–N 共 14 段
longReading.sourceNote: 2025年6月六级第1套 Section B（原文改编自 Public Libraries Online，36–45题及定位句经新东方与说客英语交叉核验）

paragraphs.scanTag: 数字化时代图书馆作为社区文化中心的价值常被低估

sentences.en: Librarians know the value of their community services, and their patrons appreciate their importance as well.
sentences.zh: 图书馆员深知社区服务的价值，读者们也同样珍视其重要性。

sentences.en: But in an increasingly digital world, we see the role of libraries as community and cultural centers at times undervalued.
sentences.zh: 但在一个日益数字化的世界里，我们看到图书馆作为社区和文化中心的角色有时被低估了。

sentences.en: When shrinking municipal budgets combine with the nonstop technological revolution, public library services that focus on building communities face-to-face, inspiring and educating patrons about art, literature, and music, and helping patrons engage in civil discourse can seem old-fashioned.
sentences.zh: 当不断缩减的市政预算遇上永不停歇的技术革命，那些致力于面对面建设社区、启发并教育读者了解艺术、文学和音乐以及帮助读者参与公民对话的公共图书馆服务，可能显得过时。

sentences.en: But it is precisely those shrinking budgets and the assault of technologically mediated life that make public libraries' cultural and community offerings more important than ever.
sentences.zh: 但恰恰是这些缩减的预算和技术主导生活的冲击，使得公共图书馆的文化与社区服务比以往任何时候都更加重要。

paragraphs.scanTag: 不止提供信息，更是社区建设者、艺术中心与青少年守护者

sentences.en: Many people point out the value public libraries bring to their communities.
sentences.zh: 许多人指出公共图书馆为社区带来的价值。

sentences.en: More than just books and banks of computers, libraries are still places where individuals gather to explore, interact, and imagine.
sentences.zh: 图书馆不仅仅是书籍和成排的电脑，它依然是人们聚集在一起探索、互动和想象的场所。

sentences.en: Some of the specific ways in which libraries add value to our communities and serve as cultural centers for our patrons are community builders, centers for the arts, and champions of youth.
sentences.zh: 图书馆为社区增值并作为读者文化中心的一些具体角色包括：社区建设者、艺术中心和青少年的守护者。

sentences.en: Libraries serve in these capacities and are more than just about information.
sentences.zh: 图书馆承担着这些职能，而不仅仅是提供信息。

paragraphs.scanTag: 支持者观点：不走出去改变社区就不算完成工作

sentences.en: As community builders libraries are engaged in incredible work.
sentences.zh: 作为社区建设者，图书馆正开展着了不起的工作。

sentences.en: From tiny public libraries to huge city institutions with multiple branches, libraries across the United States are building community and supporting local culture in exciting ways.
sentences.zh: 从微型公共图书馆到拥有多家分馆的大型城市机构，全美各地的图书馆正以令人振奋的方式建设社区并支持本土文化。

sentences.en: These are inspiring and hopefully will encourage librarians interested in community services and cultural outreach to make connections with each other, share ideas, and build partnerships.
sentences.zh: 这些举措令人鼓舞，有望激励热心社区服务和文化推广的馆员们彼此联结、分享创意并建立合作。

sentences.en: Supporters of libraries as community builders claim that unless you are out there changing neighborhoods, you are not completing the work you are to do.
sentences.zh: 支持图书馆充当社区建设者的人士声称，除非你走出去改变社区，否则就没有完成分内工作。

sentences.en: Strengthening neighborhoods and championing the cultural lives of communities are big responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 增强社区凝聚力、维护社区文化生活是重大的责任。

paragraphs.scanTag: 吸引大量人流，为周边商户创造经济机会

sentences.en: Place-based economic development stresses the importance of offering attractive, functional, and community-based places, such as libraries, in town squares and depressed neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 立足地方的经济发展强调，在城镇广场和萧条街区提供像图书馆这样有吸引力、实用且扎根社区的场所至关重要。

sentences.en: Like a major department store in a mall, libraries attract large numbers of people, creating economic opportunities for numerous businesses and organizations in the surrounding area.
sentences.zh: 就像购物中心里的主力百货商店一样，图书馆吸引大量人流，为周边众多企业和机构创造经济机会。

sentences.en: Large cities, medium-sized ones, and even small towns have successfully transformed their libraries into the hubs (枢纽) of vibrant neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 大城市、中等城市乃至小镇都已成功将图书馆改造成充满活力的社区枢纽。

paragraphs.scanTag: 干扰段：环保与地方可持续发展（农贸市场、种子借阅）

sentences.en: As key municipal agencies, and focal points for community education, libraries are major players in creating livable, environmentally friendly cities and towns.
sentences.zh: 作为重要的市政机构和社区教育焦点，图书馆是打造宜居、环保城镇的主力军。

sentences.en: The Urban Libraries Council released a report detailing the unique ways in which libraries can further sustainability at the local level.
sentences.zh: 城市图书馆理事会发布报告，详述了图书馆在地方层面推进可持续发展的独特方式。

sentences.en: Beyond ensuring that library construction projects consider environmental impact, libraries can take a lead in supporting local foods and craftsmen, like the Peabody Institute Library's partnering with local businesses to pioneer a farmers' market in their courtyard, or the Richmond Public Library's seed lending library which "nurtures locally-adapted plant varieties, and fosters community resilience (韧性), self-reliance and a culture of sharing."
sentences.zh: 除了确保图书馆建设项目考量环境影响外，图书馆还能带头支持本地食品和手工艺人，例如皮博迪学院图书馆与当地商家合作在庭院首创农贸市场，或里士满公共图书馆的种子借阅库，它“培育适应当地的植物品种，并培养社区韧性、自力更生精神和分享文化”。

paragraphs.scanTag: 档案馆（archive）助力查询家族史与移民史

sentences.en: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups.
sentences.zh: 档案馆保存着与社区（包括少数群体）相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作。

sentences.en: Communities lucky enough to have archivists have a great advantage when it comes to organizing historical records and artifacts.
sentences.zh: 有幸拥有档案管理员的社区在整理历史记录和文物方面具有巨大优势。

sentences.en: An organized archive is a place where people can research their ancestry and immigration history, do environmental research, and more.
sentences.zh: 条理清晰的档案馆是人们研究家族血统、移民史、开展环境研究等诸多事务的地方。

sentences.en: An archivist is an advocate for preservation who, among other things, coordinates the restoration of maps and paintings, the digitization of vital records, and the creation of oral history projects.
sentences.zh: 档案管理员是保护工作的倡导者，其职责包括协调地图与画作修复、重要记录数字化以及口述历史项目的创建。

sentences.en: With projects like the Massachusetts Memories Road Show and the Veterans History Project, evidence of the importance of archives is everywhere.
sentences.zh: 从“马萨诸塞记忆巡展”和“退伍军人历史项目”等案例来看，档案馆重要性的例证随处可见。

paragraphs.scanTag: Robert Putnam 名言：来查信息却结识彼此，建立社区联结

sentences.en: In the words of Robert Putnam, "People may go to the library looking mainly for information, but they find each other there."
sentences.zh: 用罗伯特·普特南的话说：“人们去图书馆可能主要是为了寻找信息，但他们在那里找到了彼此。”

sentences.en: New moms connect at baby story-times; elderly people, often facing difficult life transitions, attend events and find that they make new friends; teenagers meet up in libraries' teen spaces after school; and readers discuss current events in the periodicals room.
sentences.zh: 新手妈妈在婴儿故事会上相识；常面临艰难人生转折的老年人参加活动并结交新朋友；青少年放学后在青少年区聚会；读者在期刊室讨论时事。

sentences.en: In libraries, community-building connections are happening all the time.
sentences.zh: 在图书馆里，构建社区的人际联结无时无刻不在发生。

paragraphs.scanTag: 免费文化活动（音乐会/讲座/展览），不限收入阶层

sentences.en: As Keith Richards said, "The public library is the great equalizer."
sentences.zh: 正如基思·理查兹所说：“公共图书馆是伟大的平等器。”

sentences.en: Despite the rising costs of concert and theater tickets, public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays) are often offered free of charge, enabling people of any income level to attend.
sentences.zh: 尽管音乐会和剧院门票价格不断上涨，公共图书馆的活动（包括音乐会、作家见面会和画廊展览）通常免费开放，让任何收入阶层的人都能参与。

sentences.en: In addition, library book groups allow people to explore and discuss the literary arts, and the Great Stories Club introduces at-risk youth to literature.
sentences.zh: 此外，图书馆读书小组让人们探索和讨论文学艺术，“好故事俱乐部”则引导高危青少年接触文学。

sentences.en: The best part: it's all free and open to the public.
sentences.zh: 最棒的是：这一切都免费向公众开放。

paragraphs.scanTag: 教育越来越贵，图书馆仍向所有人免费提供教育机会

sentences.en: In a time when education is increasingly expensive, public libraries provide information and educational opportunities free for all people, regardless of their socio-economic status.
sentences.zh: 在教育越来越昂贵的时代，公共图书馆不分社会经济地位，免费为所有人提供信息和教育机会。

sentences.en: Offered by libraries across the country, American Library Association's Let's Talk about It programs are wonderful examples of scholar-facilitated learning opportunities in libraries.
sentences.zh: 全美各地图书馆开设的美国图书馆协会“让我们谈谈它”项目，正是学者引导型学习的绝佳范例。

sentences.en: In addition, many libraries present classes and discussion programs, and some even provide online continuing education courses such as the Universal Class database.
sentences.zh: 此外，许多图书馆开设课程和讨论项目，有些甚至提供诸如 Universal Class 数据库之类的在线继续教育课程。

paragraphs.scanTag: 干扰段：读者不仅是信息消费者，更是内容创作者（工作坊/播客）

sentences.en: Librarians know that patrons aren't just information consumers, they're information producers.
sentences.zh: 图书馆员知道，读者不仅是信息消费者，更是信息生产者。

sentences.en: Patrons use the library to gain knowledge in order to create their own new and independent works.
sentences.zh: 读者利用图书馆获取知识，以创作自己全新的独立作品。

sentences.en: Increasing numbers of libraries provide spaces and services that meet the needs of people who want to learn how to edit Wikipedia, set up blogs or podcasts, create their own magazines, and so much more.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的图书馆提供空间和服务，满足人们学习编辑维基百科、开设博客或播客、创办个人杂志等需求。

sentences.en: Many libraries offer art or writing workshops and groups, and some provide music practice rooms for patrons.
sentences.zh: 许多图书馆开设艺术或写作工作坊和小组，有些还为读者提供音乐排练室。

sentences.en: Programs like ImaginOn in Charlotte, North Carolina, provide exciting models that take community partnership, creativity, and creation to a new level.
sentences.zh: 像北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市 ImaginOn 这样的项目，提供了令人振奋的范式，将社区合作、创造力与创作推向新高度。

paragraphs.scanTag: 公民对话：打破同温层，建立不同背景与意识形态的小社群

sentences.en: The decline of civil discourse stems in part from the fact that it is so easy for people to watch news about, buy products from, and engage—in both the virtual and real worlds—only with those of similar backgrounds and ideologies.
sentences.zh: 公民对话的衰落部分源于：无论在虚拟还是现实世界中，人们都太容易只关注、购买并与背景和意识形态相似的人交往。

sentences.en: Public libraries, through such programs as The Human Library and Socrates Café, can help build small communities of difference that encourage people to interact with and learn from each other through dialogue.
sentences.zh: 公共图书馆通过“真人图书馆”和“苏格拉底咖啡馆”等项目，能够帮助建立多元差异的小社群，鼓励人们通过对话交流互学。

sentences.en: By both actively promoting civil discourse through these programs, and modeling and upholding the principles of free inquiry and expression for all, libraries help individuals rediscover the importance of and increased need for civil discourse in American life.
sentences.zh: 通过这些项目积极促进公民对话，并以身作则维护人人享有自由探究与表达的原则，图书馆帮助人们重新认识到公民对话在美国生活中的重要性与迫切需求。

paragraphs.scanTag: 免费辅导与暑期阅读：缩小不同经济背景学生的学业鸿沟

sentences.en: Free tutoring, homework help programs, and summer reading programs for kids and teens help bridge the economic divide that impacts students' academic performance.
sentences.zh: 面向儿童和青少年的免费辅导、作业帮助和暑期阅读项目，有助于弥合影响学生学业表现的经济鸿沟。

sentences.en: The cost of hiring a private tutor is well beyond what many library patrons can afford, so libraries offer homework help and tutoring online, by phone, in person, and even through social media and homework apps.
sentences.zh: 请私人辅导的费用远超许多读者的承受能力，因此图书馆通过网络、电话、面授甚至社交媒体和作业应用提供作业辅导。

sentences.en: Annual summer reading programs also have a positive impact on student performance and, according to a 2010 study conducted by Dominican University's Graduate School of Library and Information Science, students' reading skills get a boost from these popular nationwide events.
sentences.zh: 年度暑期阅读项目也对学生表现产生积极影响，根据多米尼加大学图书情报研究生院 2010 年的一项研究，学生的阅读技能在这些广受欢迎的全国性活动中得到了提升。

paragraphs.scanTag: 干扰段：儿童项目培养分享与探索自然（Nature Explorium）

sentences.en: Through library collections, programs, and physical spaces, children learn to share, to be engaged in their communities, to participate in the arts, and to explore their immediate world and the world at large.
sentences.zh: 通过图书馆藏书、项目和实体空间，孩子们学会分享、融入社区、参与艺术，并探索身边的世界与广阔的天地。

sentences.en: There are surely endless examples of innovative library services for children, including the Middle Country Public Library's Nature Explorium, which engages children in learning about the natural world.
sentences.zh: 面向儿童的创新图书馆服务层出不穷，其中包括中乡村公共图书馆的“自然探索园”，引导孩子们认识自然界。

paragraphs.scanTag: 结尾总结段：鼓励各地图书馆实践并说服社区领导者

sentences.en: These examples are just a few of the many amazing things that public libraries around the United States (and the world) are doing to build and maintain strong community connections.
sentences.zh: 这些例子只是全美乃至全球公共图书馆为建立和维系紧密社区联结所做诸多精彩工作的冰山一角。

sentences.en: We encourage you to try some of these ideas in your own libraries, and we hope that these ideas will help you be better able to convince your community leaders of the important role that public libraries play in communities large and small.
sentences.zh: 我们鼓励你在自己的图书馆里尝试其中一些做法，也希望这些案例能帮助你更有力地说服社区领导者认识到公共图书馆在大小社区中的重要作用。

questions.stem: People going to the library in search of information can build connections with each other there.
questions.stemZh: 去图书馆查找信息的人们可以在那里彼此建立联系。

keywords.note: 二级核心短语：对应 G 段首句 looking mainly for information
二级核心：对应 find each other 与 community-building connections

questions.scanPath: 扫各段首句，到 G 段一眼看到 Robert Putnam 引语：go to the library looking mainly for information, but they find each other there，尾句再补一刀 connections，秒选 G！
questions.evidenceQuote: People may go to the library looking mainly for information, but they find each other there. ... In libraries, community-building connections are happening all the time.

paraphrases.note: 高频短语替换：in search of = looking for
首尾句语义呼应

distractorTrap.reason: B 段和 N 段也提到了 interact / community connections，但只有 G 段明确点出“本来是去查信息，结果彼此建立联结”。

questions.stem: According to advocates of libraries as community builders, librarians are not doing their job well if they do not change their communities.
questions.stemZh: 支持图书馆作为社区建设者的人士认为，图书馆员如果不改变社区，就没有做好本职工作。

keywords.text: advocates of libraries as community builders
keywords.note: 一级专有短语：原文 C 段 Supporters of libraries as community builders
二级核心：对应 changing neighborhoods

questions.scanPath: 直扫 community builders，C 段首句即 As community builders，往后扫到 Supporters... claim that unless you are out there changing neighborhoods, you are not completing the work，精准命中 C！
questions.evidenceQuote: Supporters of libraries as community builders claim that unless you are out there changing neighborhoods, you are not completing the work you are to do.

paraphrases.note: 六级高频同义词：advocate = supporter（支持者）

paraphrases.q: if they do not change their communities
paraphrases.p: unless you are out there changing neighborhoods
paraphrases.note: 句式转换：if... not = unless；communities = neighborhoods

distractorTrap.reason: B 段也列举了 community builders，但只是总述头衔，没有提及“不改变社区就没完成工作”。

questions.stem: With the costs of education continually rising, public libraries remain places where all people can have access to education.
questions.stemZh: 随着教育成本不断攀升，公共图书馆仍然是所有人都能获得教育机会的场所。

keywords.note: 二级核心：对应 I 段首句 education is increasingly expensive

keywords.text: all people can have access to education
keywords.note: 二级核心：对应 educational opportunities free for all people

questions.scanPath: 扫 education + expensive：H 段首句是音乐会和剧院票价涨价，紧接着 I 段首句直接抛出 In a time when education is increasingly expensive，后面紧跟 educational opportunities free for all people，锁定 I！
questions.evidenceQuote: In a time when education is increasingly expensive, public libraries provide information and educational opportunities free for all people, regardless of their socio-economic status.

paraphrases.note: 高频替换：costs continually rising = increasingly expensive

paraphrases.p: provide ... educational opportunities free for all people
paraphrases.note: 视角转换：图书馆提供 = 所有人可获取

distractorTrap.reason: H 段涨价的是 concert and theater tickets（文化演出）；L 段针对的是 kids and teens 免费辅导，并非 I 段面向 all people 的教育机会。

questions.stem: Libraries draw large crowds, thus creating lots of business opportunities in neighboring areas.
questions.stemZh: 图书馆吸引大量人群，从而为周边地区创造大量商业机会。

keywords.note: 二级核心：对应 attract large numbers of people
二级核心：对应 economic opportunities for numerous businesses ... in the surrounding area

questions.scanPath: 扫 economic / businesses：D 段首句就是 Place-based economic development，第 2 句直接出现 attract large numbers of people, creating economic opportunities for numerous businesses ... in the surrounding area，一秒锁 D！
questions.evidenceQuote: Like a major department store in a mall, libraries attract large numbers of people, creating economic opportunities for numerous businesses and organizations in the surrounding area.

paraphrases.note: 动词替换：draw = attract；crowds = large numbers of people
高频空间词替换：neighboring = surrounding

distractorTrap.reason: E 段提到了 partnering with local businesses 开农贸市场，但讲的是环保与可持续发展，并非“吸引大客流带动周边商机”。

questions.stem: With the world more and more digitalized, people sometimes underestimate the role of libraries as community and cultural centers.
questions.stemZh: 随着世界越来越数字化，人们有时会低估图书馆作为社区和文化中心的作用。

keywords.note: 二级硬词：对应 A 段 increasingly digital world
二级核心：对应 undervalued
一级原词复现

questions.scanPath: 扫 digitalized / cultural centers，A 段第 2 句原封不动出现 increasingly digital world + role of libraries as community and cultural centers at times undervalued，直接秒杀 A！
questions.evidenceQuote: But in an increasingly digital world, we see the role of libraries as community and cultural centers at times undervalued.

paraphrases.note: 高频副词替换：more and more = increasingly
核心动词替换：sometimes = at times；underestimate = undervalue

distractorTrap.reason: B 段也提到了 cultural centers，但没有提及数字化时代被“低估”的痛点。

questions.stem: Various programs organized by public libraries for children and adolescents help narrow the gap between students from varying economic backgrounds.
questions.stemZh: 公共图书馆为儿童和青少年组织的各类项目有助于缩小不同经济背景学生之间的差距。

keywords.note: 二级核心：对应 L 段 kids and teens
二级核心：对应 bridge the economic divide

questions.scanPath: 扫 kids / teens / economic divide：L 段首句列举 Free tutoring, homework help, summer reading programs for kids and teens，紧接着 help bridge the economic divide，稳锁 L！
questions.evidenceQuote: Free tutoring, homework help programs, and summer reading programs for kids and teens help bridge the economic divide that impacts students' academic performance.

paraphrases.note: 六级高频同义替换：adolescents = teens（青少年）
经典隐喻替换：narrow the gap = bridge the divide（弥合鸿沟）

distractorTrap.reason: M 段也讲儿童图书馆项目（Nature Explorium），但侧重探索自然与学会分享，没有涉及缩小经济鸿沟。

questions.stem: In an organized archive, people can do research on their family history and find out how their ancestors came to settle in the new land.
questions.stemZh: 在条理清晰的档案馆里，人们可以研究家族历史，了解祖先是如何来到新土地定居的。

keywords.note: 一级专有名词原词复现：全篇仅 F 段大篇幅讲 Archives！

keywords.text: family history / ancestors ... settle in the new land
keywords.note: 二级核心：对应 ancestry and immigration history

questions.scanPath: 一眼锁定一级硬词 organized archive，全篇只有 F 段首句是 Archives，第 3 句原词出现 An organized archive is a place where people can research their ancestry and immigration history，10 秒秒杀 F！
questions.evidenceQuote: An organized archive is a place where people can research their ancestry and immigration history, do environmental research, and more.

paraphrases.note: 同义替换：family history = ancestry（祖先/家世）

paraphrases.q: how their ancestors came to settle in the new land
paraphrases.note: 释义展开：移民史 = 祖先如何来到新土地定居

distractorTrap.reason: archive 为强辨识度专有词，全文仅 F 段出现，注意不要把 immigration history 看漏。

questions.stem: Public libraries organize cultural events, often allowing people of different income levels to attend free of charge.
questions.stemZh: 公共图书馆组织文化活动，通常允许不同收入阶层的人免费参加。

keywords.note: 一级精准词：对应 H 段 people of any income level
一级原词复现：free of charge

questions.scanPath: 直扫 income level + free of charge：H 段第 2 句直接出现 public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays) are often offered free of charge, enabling people of any income level to attend，锁定 H！
questions.evidenceQuote: Despite the rising costs of concert and theater tickets, public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays) are often offered free of charge, enabling people of any income level to attend.

paraphrases.p: public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays)
paraphrases.note: 上下义概括：音乐会/作家见面会/画展 = 文化活动
几乎原词复现

distractorTrap.reason: I 段也有 free for all people, regardless of their socio-economic status，但 I 段聚焦的是“教育课程（educational opportunities）”，H 段才是“文化演出活动”。

questions.stem: Besides being an information provider, the library performs many other important services for the community.
questions.stemZh: 除了作为信息提供者，图书馆还为社区提供许多其他重要服务。

keywords.note: 二级核心：对应 B 段尾句 more than just about information
二级核心：对应 serve in these capacities (community builders, centers for the arts, champions of youth)

questions.scanPath: 这道题没有硬专有名词，容易在 A/B/J 之间犹豫。抓住关键逻辑“不止是信息（Besides being an information provider）”，B 段尾句直白写出 Libraries serve in these capacities and are more than just about information，精准锁定 B！
questions.evidenceQuote: Some of the specific ways in which libraries add value to our communities and serve as cultural centers for our patrons are community builders, centers for the arts, and champions of youth. Libraries serve in these capacities and are more than just about information.

paraphrases.note: 结构替换：besides = more than just
动词对应：perform services = serve in capacities

distractorTrap.reason: J 段说读者不止是 information consumers 还是 information producers，主语是“读者”而非“图书馆为社区提供多项服务”。

questions.stem: Public libraries can help build small communities of people with different backgrounds and ideologies.
questions.stemZh: 公共图书馆能够帮助建立由不同背景和意识形态人群组成的小社群。

keywords.note: 一级原词复现：K 段 build small communities of difference
一级硬词复现：K 段首句 backgrounds and ideologies

questions.scanPath: 直接扫长难硬词 ideologies！全篇仅 K 段首句出现 similar backgrounds and ideologies，紧接着第 2 句就是 can help build small communities of difference，稳稳秒杀 K！
questions.evidenceQuote: ...only with those of similar backgrounds and ideologies. Public libraries, through such programs as The Human Library and Socrates Café, can help build small communities of difference...

paraphrases.q: people with different backgrounds and ideologies
paraphrases.p: of difference (contrasted with similar backgrounds and ideologies)
paraphrases.note: 跨句整合：第1句背景+意识形态 + 第2句 small communities of difference

distractorTrap.reason: C、G 段虽都在讲社区建设，但全篇只有 K 段涉及“意识形态（ideologies）”和“差异小社群”。

readingA.title: Passage One · 模拟训练与组织变革（46–50题）
readingA.sourceCitation: 出处：Brian Klapper, Chief Learning Officer ("When Simulation Is Better Than Reality")
readingA.sourceLabel: Chief Learning Officer / 新东方 2025年6月第2套 Passage 1

sentences.en: Simulators are most often utilized within industries such as nuclear power, aviation and surgery where failure results in disastrous consequences.
sentences.zh: 模拟器最常用于核电、航空和外科手术等一旦失误就会造成灾难性后果的行业。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:46:trap-46-d:46D 挖坑:To maximize the value from a simulation learning experience, participants should immediately and directly apply their learning to a specific intervention within their organization.}}
sentences.zh: 为了最大限度地发挥模拟学习体验的价值，参与者应当立即且直接地将所学应用到组织内部的某项具体干预举措中。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:46:trap-46-a:46A 挖坑:Most organizations aspire to deploy significant change programs, only to find them nearly impossible to implement.}}
sentences.zh: 大多数机构渴望推行重大变革项目，结果却发现几乎无法落地实施。

sentences.en: {{HIT:46:hit-46:46C 正解依据:That is largely because successful change requires more than {{TRAP:46:trap-46-b:46B 挖坑:a vision}}, it requires a workforce that not only doesn't resist change, but embraces it.}}
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上是因为成功的变革不仅需要愿景，更需要一支不仅不抵制变革、反而积极拥抱变革的员工队伍。

sentence.tag: P2 长难句拆解 · 递进结构 not only... but...（Q46 定位）

chunks.text: That is largely because successful change requires more than a vision,
it requires a workforce
that not only doesn't resist change, but embraces it.

sentence.analysis: embraces it（欣然拥抱变革）直接对应 46C 的 enthusiastic support from the workforce。

sentences.en: To achieve success, an organization must build a transformation program that will allow change to be rapidly pulled across its departments and throughout its layers.
sentences.zh: 为了取得成功，机构必须建立一套转型项目，使变革能够迅速贯穿各个部门与层级。

sentences.en: Regardless of the level of senior management commitment, unless key thought leaders at all levels embrace the change, the initiative will wither and die.
sentences.zh: 无论高层管理者的决心有多大，除非各层级的关键思想领袖都拥抱变革，否则这项举措终将枯萎夭折。

sentences.en: {{HIT:47:hit-47:47A 正解依据:To create this kind of widespread passion, learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be}}, which will {{TRAP:47:trap-47-bcd:47B/C/D 挖坑:enable them to rethink their mental models, enable them to break free from their deep-rooted paradigms and embrace the opportunity to learn}}.
sentences.zh: 为了激发这种广泛的热情，学习负责人必须让员工看到未来的可能性，从而促使他们重新审视固有思维模式、打破根深蒂固的范式并拥抱学习机会。

sentence.tag: P3 长难句拆解 · 手段与结果分清（Q47 防坑关键）

chunks.text: To create this kind of widespread passion,
learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be,
which will enable them to rethink their mental models, break free from deep-rooted paradigms and embrace the opportunity to learn.

sentence.analysis: 本题最大陷阱在于 B/C/D 三个选项全出自 which 之后的“后续效果”，而真正回答“学习负责人该做什么来激发热情”的直接动作是 expose the workforce to what could be（47A）。

sentences.en: Allowing participants to enter a simulated environment provides them with the opportunity to experience alternative realities which can prompt them to rethink their current beliefs.
sentences.zh: 让参与者进入模拟环境，可以为他们提供体验不同现实场景的机会，从而促使他们重新审视现有观念。

sentences.en: Behavioral change is not easy for most adults.
sentences.zh: 对大多数成年人来说，改变行为并不容易。

sentences.en: {{HIT:48:hit-48:48A 正解依据:Lectures, training programs and workshops can explain the intellectual elements of transformation, but they are seldom effective at getting to the behavioral aspects that lie at the heart of a significant change initiative.}}
sentences.zh: 讲座、培训项目和工作坊可以解释转型中的认知要素，但它们很少能有效触及重大变革核心处的行为层面。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:48:trap-48-d:48D 挖坑:Further, under normal working conditions, managers rarely see the full effect of their employee development efforts.}}
sentences.zh: 此外，在正常工作条件下，管理者很少能看到员工培养举措的全部成效。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:48:trap-48-b:48B 挖坑:As such, an intervention like a simulation can provide the stimulus for change.}}
sentences.zh: 因此，像模拟训练这样的干预措施可以提供变革的刺激动力。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:49:trap-49-a:49A 挖坑:An effective simulation can be better than experience as a learning tool because it accelerates time, compresses space, and unlike reality, is specifically designed to maximize participant learning.}}
sentences.zh: 高效的模拟训练作为学习工具可能比真实经验更胜一筹，因为它能加速时间、压缩空间，而且不同于现实，它是专门为最大化参与者学习效果而设计的。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:49:trap-49-bc:49B/C 挖坑:Simulations provide an immersive learning experience where skills, processes and knowledge all can be highlighted in a way reality cannot.}}
sentences.zh: 模拟训练提供一种沉浸式学习体验，能以现实无法企及的方式凸显技能、流程和知识。

sentences.en: {{HIT:49:hit-49:49D 正解依据:The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning.}}
sentences.zh: 能够在无限、无风险的模型中探索、试验并反复应用新知识，正是使模拟成为最高效学习方式之一的原因。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:50:trap-50-c:50C 挖坑:Well-designed simulations can enable individuals and groups to develop a deep level of understanding about how their decisions and intuitive responses to business stimuli affect their fellow participants and the organization as a whole.}}
sentences.zh: 精心设计的模拟训练能让个人和团队深刻理解，自己对商业刺激所作的决策和直觉反应如何影响同伴及整个组织。

sentences.en: To reap the benefits, however, simulations must feel like reality. At the end of the successful simulation, participants must declare "this is us."
sentences.zh: 然而，要收获成效，模拟必须感觉像现实一样。成功的模拟结束时，参与者必须感叹“这就是我们”。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:50:trap-50-a:50A 挖坑:If they don't, they will view the experience as a game, which can be difficult to apply on the job, or worse, irrelevant to everyday work tasks.}}
sentences.zh: 否则，他们就会把这段经历当成一场游戏，既难以应用到工作中，更糟的是会与日常工作任务脱节。

sentences.en: {{HIT:50:hit-50:50B 正解依据:To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing.}}
sentences.zh: 为了从模拟训练中获得最大收益，参与者应当立即将从体验中学到的内容付诸实践，在“学”与“做”之间建立顺畅衔接。

questions.qTypeTip: 扫 successful change 定位 P2 末句，注意 more than A, it requires B 结构——考点一定落在 B 上！
questions.stem: What do we learn about successful changes in organizations?
questions.stemZh: 关于组织中的成功变革，我们了解到什么？
questions.step1Tip: 定位 P2 第 2 句 successful change requires more than a vision, it requires a workforce that ... embraces it。

options.text: They can be immediately implemented with great ease.
options.zh: 它们可以轻而易举地立即实施。
options.reason: P2 首句明确说大多数机构发现变革项目“几乎无法实施（nearly impossible to implement）”。

options.text: They are usually led by organization leaders of vision.
options.zh: 它们通常由有远见的组织领导者带领。
options.reason: 原文强调“光有愿景不够（requires more than a vision）”，重点在后半句员工队伍的拥抱。

options.text: They call for enthusiastic support from the workforce.
options.zh: 它们需要来自员工队伍的热情支持。
options.reason: call for = requires；enthusiastic support = not only doesn't resist, but embraces it。

options.text: They often result from simulation learning experiences.
options.zh: 它们往往源于模拟学习体验。
options.reason: P1 只是说模拟学习需要结合组织干预，未说成功变革“往往源于”模拟体验。

questions.locQuote: That is largely because successful change requires more than a vision, it requires a workforce that not only doesn't resist change, but embraces it.
questions.synonymFrom: requires a workforce that ... embraces it
questions.synonymTo: call for enthusiastic support from the workforce

questions.qTypeLabel: 细节题 · 手段 vs 结果
questions.qTypeTip: 超高频经典坑：原文是“做 X（手段），which will enable them to Y1, Y2, Y3（后续结果）”，问如何做时务必选 X，排除把 Y1/Y2/Y3 当手段的 B/C/D！
questions.stem: What should learning leaders do to arouse learners' passion for change?
questions.stemZh: 学习负责人应该怎么做来激发学习者对变革的热情？
questions.step1Tip: 定位 P3 末句 To create this kind of widespread passion, learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be。

options.text: Allow them to see what could possibly be achieved.
options.zh: 让他们看到未来可能实现的前景。
options.reason: 精准替换 expose the workforce to what could be（让员工接触/看到未来的可能性）。

options.text: Help them break free from their old paradigms.
options.zh: 帮助他们打破旧范式。
options.reason: 这是 expose to what could be 之后 which 引导的后续结果，而非第一步做法。

options.text: Encourage them to rethink their thought models.
options.zh: 鼓励他们重新思考思维模式。
options.reason: 同属 which 引导的后续结果。

options.text: Stimulate them to embrace fresh opportunities.
options.zh: 激励他们拥抱新机会。
options.reason: 同属 which 引导的后续结果，且原文是 embrace the opportunity to learn。

questions.locQuote: To create this kind of widespread passion, learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be...
questions.synonymFrom: expose the workforce to what could be
questions.synonymTo: Allow them to see what could possibly be achieved

questions.qTypeTip: 题干直接给出三个并列名词 Lectures, training programs and workshops，秒回 P5 第 2 句，重点读 but 后面的否定评价 seldom effective！
questions.stem: What does the passage say about lectures, training programs and workshops?
questions.stemZh: 关于讲座、培训项目和工作坊，文章说了什么？
questions.step1Tip: 定位 P5 第 2 句，直接看转折词 but 后：seldom effective at getting to the behavioral aspects。

options.text: They are generally incapable of changing workers' behaviors on the job.
options.zh: 它们通常无法改变员工在工作中的行为。
options.reason: generally incapable of changing behaviors 精准对应 seldom effective at getting to the behavioral aspects。

options.text: They are interventions different from simulations in creating stimuli for change.
options.zh: 它们在制造变革刺激方面是不同于模拟训练的干预手段。
options.reason: 原文说的是模拟训练（simulation）能提供变革刺激，而非讲座培训能制造刺激。

options.text: They aim at transforming the behaviors of the workers in an organization.
options.zh: 它们旨在改变组织中员工的行为。
options.reason: 原文说它们只能解释认知要素（intellectual elements），难以触及行为改变。

options.text: They help managers achieve the full effect of employee development efforts.
options.zh: 它们帮助管理者实现员工发展举措的全部效果。
options.reason: 原文明确说 managers rarely see the full effect（很少能看到全部成效）。

questions.locQuote: Lectures, training programs and workshops can explain the intellectual elements of transformation, but they are seldom effective at getting to the behavioral aspects that lie at the heart of a significant change initiative.
questions.synonymFrom: seldom effective at getting to the behavioral aspects
questions.synonymTo: generally incapable of changing workers' behaviors

questions.qTypeTip: 题干问 makes simulation one of the most fruitful forms of learning，回 P6 尾句找原句框架 is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning！
questions.stem: What makes simulation one of the most fruitful forms of learning?
questions.stemZh: 是什么使模拟训练成为最具成效的学习方式之一？
questions.step1Tip: 直接锁定 P6 末句 productive = fruitful，主语即答案：explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models。

options.text: Its capability of saving time by accelerating the immersive learning experience.
options.zh: 它通过加速沉浸式学习体验来节省时间的能力。
options.reason: 混拼 P6 第 1 句 accelerates time 与第 2 句 immersive learning experience，并非末句直接点明的根本原因。

options.text: Its potential for learners to examine their skills, knowledge and learning process.
options.zh: 它让学习者检验自身技能、知识和学习过程的潜力。
options.reason: P6 第 2 句是 skills, processes and knowledge can be highlighted，而非“检验学习过程”。

options.text: Its capability of providing all participants with a practical learning experience.
options.zh: 它为所有参与者提供实用学习体验的能力。
options.reason: 原文是 immersive（沉浸式），且未对应末句的 productive 原因。

options.text: Its potential for learners to explore, experiment and practice without any risk.
options.zh: 它让学习者在毫无风险的情况下探索、试验和反复练习的潜力。
options.reason: 精准对应 P6 末句 explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models。

questions.locQuote: The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning.
questions.synonymFrom: explore, experiment and repeatedly apply ... in unlimited, risk-free models
questions.synonymTo: explore, experiment and practice without any risk

questions.qTypeTip: 锁定 reap the greatest benefits possible → 对应 P7 末句 To maximize benefits from simulation（且首段尾句也首尾呼应了同一句话！）。
questions.stem: What should participants do in a simulation to reap the greatest benefits possible?
questions.stemZh: 参与者在模拟训练中应该做什么才能获得尽可能大的收益？
questions.step1Tip: 直接锁定 P7 末句 To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning。

options.text: Take the experience as a mere game.
options.zh: 把这段经历仅仅当成一场游戏。
options.reason: 原文明确指出当成游戏是模拟失败后的负面结果，难以应用到工作中。

options.text: Apply promptly what they learn to their jobs.
options.zh: 将所学内容迅速应用到工作中。
options.reason: promptly = immediately；精准替换 P7 末句（及 P1 末句）immediately apply the learning。

options.text: Develop a deep level of understanding.
options.zh: 培养深刻的理解。
options.reason: 这是精心设计的模拟所能带来的效果（enable... to develop），而非最大化收益时参与者应采取的行动。

options.text: Strive to connect closely with their leaders.
options.zh: 努力与领导建立紧密联系。
options.reason: 原文是 forge a smooth link between learning and doing（连接学与做），不是联系领导。

questions.locQuote: To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing.
questions.synonymFrom: immediately apply the learning from the experience
questions.synonymTo: Apply promptly what they learn to their jobs

readingB.title: Passage Two · 超越 GDP：政府应以公民幸福感为目标（51–55题）
readingB.sourceCitation: 出处：Imogen Smith, Centre for Thriving Places ("Governments must focus on happiness")
readingB.sourceLabel: Centre for Thriving Places / 新东方 2025年6月第2套 Passage 2

sentences.en: {{TRAP:51:trap-51-cd:51C/D 挖坑:GDP growth is not a good indicator of how well a country is performing, and should not be the primary goal of governments.}}
sentences.zh: GDP 增长并不是衡量一个国家表现好坏的良好指标，也不应成为政府的首要目标。

sentences.en: {{HIT:51:hit-51:51A 正解依据:Unlimited growth is not sustainable, and economic thinking is moving toward the idea that we should aim for sustainability in our economic models.}}
sentences.zh: 无节制的增长不可持续，如今的经济学思维正转向在经济模式中追求可持续性。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:51:trap-51-b:51B 挖坑:But while a sustainable economy is vital to our future, it is a means to an end, not an end in itself.}}
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管可持续经济对我们的未来至关重要，它只是实现目的的手段，而非目的本身。

sentences.en: The idea that governments should focus on happiness has its critics. There are concerns about how happiness can be measured.
sentences.zh: 政府应关注幸福感这一理念招致了不少批评。人们担心幸福感该如何衡量。

sentences.en: Is happiness not a fleeting and subjective psychological state? Don't different people experience different levels of happiness?
sentences.zh: 幸福难道不是一种转瞬即逝且主观的心理状态吗？不同的人体验到的幸福程度难道不各不相同吗？

sentences.en: {{HIT:52:hit-52:52C 正解依据:Even on the broadest interpretation of 'happiness' as prosperity or 'life satisfaction', people want different things.}}
sentences.zh: 即便把“幸福”做最宽泛的解读，将其视为繁荣或“生活满意度”，不同的人想要的东西也各不相同。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:52:trap-52-ab:52A/B 挖坑:Of course, governments cannot impose life satisfaction on citizens. But our happiness relies on collaborative efforts as a society.}}
sentences.zh: 当然，政府不能把生活满意度强加给公民。但我们的幸福依赖于全社会的共同努力。

sentences.en: A government's obligation lies in creating conditions that promote prosperity. And there is good reason to suppose that such conditions exist, are globally applicable, and are discoverable through research.
sentences.zh: 政府的责任在于创造促进繁荣的条件。而且我们有充分理由认为，这些条件客观存在、全球适用，并且可以通过研究加以发现。

sentences.en: In a recently published article, philosopher Julian Baggini suggests we should focus on 'real wealth' for citizens, which does not depend on GDP growth.
sentences.zh: 在最近发表的一篇文章中，哲学家朱利安·巴吉尼建议我们应当关注不依赖于 GDP 增长的公民“真实财富”。

sentences.en: {{HIT:53:hit-53:53B 正解依据:Access is key: people do not need to own, but rather access things that enable them to live well.}}
sentences.zh: 获取渠道才是关键：人们不需要拥有，而是需要能够获取使他们过上美好生活的事物。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:53:trap-53-cd:53C/D 挖坑:Technological advances and changes in social behavior enable us to make more efficient use of the assets that we already have.}}
sentences.zh: 技术进步与社会行为的变化使我们能够更高效地利用现有资产。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:53:trap-53-a:53A 挖坑:And focusing on access to the resources people need to live better lives could help reduce inequality.}}
sentences.zh: 而聚焦于让人们获取过上更好生活所需的资源，有助于缩小不平等。

sentence.tag: P4 长难句拆解 · 冒号解释核心主张（Q53 定位）

chunks.text: Access is key:
people do not need to own, but rather access things
that enable them to live well.

sentence.analysis: 冒号后紧跟 not... but rather... 结构强调核心：重点不是“拥有（own）”，而是“获取（access）过上美好生活所需的资源”，直接锁定 53B。

sentences.en: As far as it goes, this has much in common with proposals tabled by 'happiness' advocates. But it sets the bar far too low for what governments can and should be doing for their citizens.
sentences.zh: 就其本身而言，这与“幸福感”倡导者提出的方案有许多共同点。但它把政府能够且应当为公民做的事情标准定得太低了。

sentences.en: For example, it's not clear how a 'real wealth' economy would remedy the epidemic of mental ill-health that plagues our society.
sentences.zh: 例如，尚不清楚“真实财富”经济如何能治愈困扰我们社会的心理健康危机。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:54:trap-54-c:54C 挖坑:In Western countries, at least—poor mental health is more detrimental to well-being than poverty.}}
sentences.zh: 至少在西方国家，心理健康不佳对幸福感的危害甚至超过贫困。

sentences.en: Over and above a vastly improved provision of therapeutic mental healthcare, there are preventative measures for improving mental health that governments could and should adopt.
sentences.zh: 除了大幅改善治疗性心理医疗服务之外，政府还可以且应当采取预防性措施来提升心理健康水平。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:54:trap-54-b:54B 挖坑:The WHO recommends establishing institutions that facilitate community participation—educational programs and interventions that provide skills for promoting mental well-being.}}
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织建议建立促进社区参与的机构——即提供促进心理健康技能的教育项目与干预措施。

sentences.en: It says a lot, however, that the WHO feels the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to persuade governments that the cost of taking proposed measures is justified.
sentences.zh: 然而，世卫组织觉得有必要诉诸改善心理健康的经济效益，才能说服各国政府相信采取这些建议措施的成本是合理的，这本身就很说明问题。

sentences.en: {{HIT:54:hit-54:54D 正解依据:As long as the economy is their priority, governments need go no further than ensuring citizens' continued productivity.}}
sentences.zh: 只要经济仍是政府的优先事项，政府就只需做到确保公民持续保持生产力为止。

sentence.tag: P6 长难句拆解 · 形式主语 It says a lot that...（Q54 背景+因果）

chunks.text: It says a lot, however,
that the WHO feels the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health
to persuade governments that the cost of taking proposed measures is justified.

sentence.analysis: It says a lot that... 意为“……很能说明问题”。说明什么问题？紧接末句点破：As long as the economy is their priority...（因为政府依然把经济发展放在首位），直接锁定 54D！

sentences.en: {{HIT:55:hit-55:55B 正解依据:To demand that governments set the 'happiness' of citizens as their highest priority is to demand that they view citizens as ends in themselves.}}
sentences.zh: 要求政府将公民的“幸福”设为最高优先事项，本质上就是要求政府将公民本身视为目的（以人为本）。

questions.qTypeTip: 锁定 more recent thinking → 对应 P1 第 2 句 economic thinking is moving toward the idea that...！
questions.stem: What does the passage say is the more recent thinking of economic growth?
questions.stemZh: 文章称关于经济增长的最新观念是什么？
questions.step1Tip: 定位 P1 第 2 句 economic thinking is moving toward the idea that we should aim for sustainability。

options.text: It should be made sustainable.
options.zh: 它应当被打造为可持续的。
options.reason: 精准对应 aim for sustainability in our economic models。

options.text: It is vital to the future of humanity.
options.zh: 它对人类未来至关重要。
options.reason: P1 末句说对未来 vital 的是“可持续经济（a sustainable economy）”，不是泛指经济增长，且这是让步句。

options.text: It should be governments' chief concern.
options.zh: 它应当成为政府的首要关切。
options.reason: P1 首句明确说 GDP growth should NOT be the primary goal of governments。

options.text: It is an indicator of government performance.
options.zh: 它是衡量政府表现的指标。
options.reason: P1 首句明确否定：is NOT a good indicator。

questions.locQuote: Unlimited growth is not sustainable, and economic thinking is moving toward the idea that we should aim for sustainability in our economic models.
questions.synonymFrom: economic thinking is moving toward ... aim for sustainability
questions.synonymTo: more recent thinking ... It should be made sustainable

questions.qTypeTip: 锁定 opposed to → 对应 P2 首句 has its critics，只在 P2 内找批评者的理由，不要串到 P3 作者的让步回应！
questions.stem: Why are some people opposed to the idea that governments should focus on happiness?
questions.stemZh: 为什么一些人反对政府应当关注幸福感这一想法？
questions.step1Tip: 锁定 P2 全段批评者质疑：难以衡量、主观易逝、不同人幸福感不同、people want different things。

options.text: Governments cannot impose happiness on citizens.
options.zh: 政府无法把幸福强加给公民。
options.reason: 这是 P3 作者自己的客观前提让步，并非 P2 批评者反对的核心理由。

options.text: People's happiness is built upon their own endeavor.
options.zh: 人们的幸福建立在自身努力之上。
options.reason: P3 说幸福依赖全社会协作（collaborative efforts as a society），而非单靠个人努力。

options.text: Happiness means different things to different people.
options.zh: 幸福对不同的人意味着不同的东西。
options.reason: 精准概括 P2 后三句：不同人体验不同程度的幸福，且 people want different things。

options.text: Happiness depends on sustainable economic growth.
options.zh: 幸福取决于可持续的经济增长。
options.reason: P2 未提及此观点。

questions.locQuote: Don't different people experience different levels of happiness? Even on the broadest interpretation of 'happiness' as prosperity or 'life satisfaction', people want different things.
questions.synonymFrom: different people experience different levels ... people want different things
questions.synonymTo: Happiness means different things to different people

questions.qTypeTip: 人名定位 Julian Baggini（P4），抓住冒号后的核心主张 Access is key 以及末句 access to the resources people need to live better lives！
questions.stem: What does philosopher Julian Baggini suggest governments do in a recently published article?
questions.stemZh: 哲学家朱利安·巴吉尼在最近发表的文章中建议政府做什么？
questions.step1Tip: 锁定 P4 两处关键词 access：access things that enable them to live well + access to the resources people need to live better lives。

options.text: Try to reduce inequality between the rich and the poor.
options.zh: 设法减少贫富差距。
options.reason: reduce inequality 是“聚焦资源获取”可能带来的积极结果（could help），而非核心做法本身。

options.text: Provide people with access to resources for a better life.
options.zh: 为人们提供获取更美好生活所需资源的渠道。
options.reason: 精准对应 P4 的 Access is key 与 focusing on access to the resources people need to live better lives。

options.text: Change people's behaviors to put social wealth to better use.
options.zh: 改变人们的行为以更好利用社会财富。
options.reason: 原文说的是社会行为的变化“使我们能够（enable us）”更高效利用现有资产，并非建议政府去改变民众行为。

options.text: Make use of advanced technologies to improve people's lives.
options.zh: 利用先进技术改善人们的生活。
options.reason: 技术进步只是客观背景条件，核心主张是 Access is key。

questions.locQuote: Access is key: people do not need to own, but rather access things that enable them to live well. ... focusing on access to the resources people need to live better lives could help reduce inequality.
questions.synonymFrom: access to the resources people need to live better lives
questions.synonymTo: Provide people with access to resources for a better life

questions.qTypeTip: 定位 P6 的 WHO feels the need to appeal to the economic benefits，答案紧跟在下一句点破真相：As long as the economy is their priority...
questions.stem: Why does the WHO feel the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to justify its recommendations?
questions.stemZh: 为什么世卫组织觉得有必要诉诸改善心理健康的经济效益来证明其建议的合理性？
questions.step1Tip: 定位 P6 倒数第 2 句，顺读紧跟其后的 P6 末句：As long as the economy is their priority...

options.text: Mental health programs cannot be executed without GDP growth.
options.zh: 没有 GDP 增长就无法推行心理健康项目。
options.reason: 原文从未说心理项目离不开 GDP 增长。

options.text: Psychological interventions are conducive to people's well-being.
options.zh: 心理干预有益于人们的幸福感。
options.reason: 这解释不了为何必须用“经济效益”去说服政府。

options.text: Poor mental health is detrimental to a nation's economic system.
options.zh: 心理健康不佳有害于国家经济体系。
options.reason: P6 第 2 句说心理健康不佳有害于“幸福感（well-being）”，而非国家经济体系。

options.text: Governments still take economic development as their priority.
options.zh: 政府仍然把经济发展作为首要任务。
options.reason: 精准对应 P6 末句 As long as the economy is their priority（因为政府眼里仍是经济第一，世卫组织才不得不打经济牌）。

questions.locQuote: It says a lot, however, that the WHO feels the need to appeal to the economic benefits... As long as the economy is their priority, governments need go no further than ensuring citizens' continued productivity.
questions.synonymFrom: As long as the economy is their priority
