longReading.wordCount: 约 1,230 词 · A–P 共 16 段
longReading.sourceNote: 2025年6月六级第2套 Section B（原文改编自 BBC Future，已逐一对照外刊原文修正网络汇编的 OCR 拼写误差）

paragraphs.scanTag: 引入段：作者自述是不情愿的社交者，曾参加10天静默禅修

sentences.en: I can be a reluctant socialiser. I'm sometimes secretly pleased when social plans are called off.
sentences.zh: 我算是个不太情愿社交的人。社交计划被取消时，我有时会暗自窃喜。

sentences.en: I get restless a few hours into a hangout. I even once went on a free 10-day silent meditation (冥想) retreat—not for the meditation, but for the silence.
sentences.zh: 聚会进行几个小时后我就会坐立不安。我甚至曾参加过一次免费的 10 天静默冥想静修——不是为了冥想，而是为了那份安静。

paragraphs.scanTag: 作家 Anneli Rufus：独处房间是享受，被迫陪表哥玩反而是惩罚

sentences.en: So I can relate to author Anneli Rufus, who wrote in Party of One: The Loners' Manifesto:
sentences.zh: 因此我能理解作家安妮莉·鲁弗斯，她在《独行者宣言》中写道：

sentences.en: "When parents on TV shows punished their kids by ordering them to go to their rooms, I was confused. I loved my room. Being there behind a locked door was a treat. To me a punishment was being ordered to play games with my cousin Louis."
sentences.zh: “当电视剧里的父母罚孩子回房间时，我感到很困惑。我爱我的房间。锁上门待在里面简直是一种享受。对我来说，惩罚是被命令去和表哥路易斯玩游戏。”

paragraphs.scanTag: 大量研究表明社交孤立在老龄化国家危害严重（早逝风险堪比糖尿病）

sentences.en: Unsocial tendencies like these are often far from ideal.
sentences.zh: 像这样的不爱社交倾向往往远非理想。

sentences.en: Abundant research shows the harms of social isolation, considered a serious public health problem in countries that have rapidly ageing populations (though talk of a 'loneliness epidemic' may be exaggerated).
sentences.zh: 大量研究表明社交孤立的危害——在人口迅速老龄化的国家，这被视为严重的公共卫生问题（尽管所谓“孤独流行病”的说法可能有些夸大）。

sentences.en: In the UK, the Royal College of General Practitioners says that loneliness has the same risk level for premature death as diabetes. Strong social connections are important for cognitive functioning, motor function and a smoothly running immune system.
sentences.zh: 在英国，皇家全科医师学院指出，孤独导致过早死亡的风险水平与糖尿病相当。稳固的社会联系对认知功能、运动功能及免疫系统顺畅运转都很重要。

paragraphs.scanTag: 干扰段：极端被迫孤立（囚禁、单独监禁）会导致幻觉与精神失常

sentences.en: This is especially clear from cases of extreme social isolation.
sentences.zh: 这一点在极端社交孤立的案例中尤为明显。

sentences.en: Examples of people kept in captivity, children kept isolated in abusive orphanages, and prisoners kept in solitary confinement all show how prolonged solitude can lead to hallucinations (幻觉) and other forms of mental instability.
sentences.zh: 被囚禁的人、在虐待型孤儿院被隔绝的儿童以及被单独监禁的囚犯等案例都表明，长期孤立会导致幻觉和其他形式的精神失常。

paragraphs.scanTag: 转折段：新研究表明主动独处对工作生活和情绪健康都有好处

sentences.en: But these are severe and involuntary cases of aloofness.
sentences.zh: 但这些都是严重且非自愿的孤立案例。

sentences.en: For those of us who just prefer plenty of alone time, emerging research suggests some good news: there are upsides to being alone—for both our work lives and our emotional well-being.
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些只是偏爱充足独处时间的人来说，新兴研究带来了好消息：独处是有益处的——无论是对我们的工作生活还是情绪健康皆是如此。

paragraphs.scanTag: 过渡段：快节奏竞争社会中独处是反思的珍贵时光

sentences.en: Solitude is a time for reflection, for thinking about things more deeply. In a world increasingly focused on speed and competitiveness, solitude is precious and something to be treasured. And there are benefits in learning to love your solitude.
sentences.zh: 独处是反思与深度思考的时刻。在一个日益追求速度与竞争的世界里，独处弥足珍贵、值得珍惜。学会爱上独处大有裨益。

paragraphs.scanTag: Gregory Feist 研究艺术家与科学家：富有创造力的人对社交兴趣较低

sentences.en: One key benefit of solitude is improved creativity.
sentences.zh: 独处的一大关键益处是提升创造力。

sentences.en: Gregory Feist, who focuses on the psychology of creativity at California's San Jose State University, has defined creativity as thinking or activity with two key elements: originality and usefulness.
sentences.zh: 加州圣何塞州立大学研究创造力心理学的格雷戈里·费斯特，将创造力定义为包含原创性与实用性两大关键要素的思维或活动。

sentences.en: He has found that personality traits commonly associated with creativity are openness (receptiveness to new thoughts and experiences), self-confidence, and autonomy—which may include "a lack of concern for social norms" and "a preference for being alone".
sentences.zh: 他发现与创造力密切相关的人格特质包括开放性（乐于接受新思想与新体验）、自信和自主性——其中可能包含“不在意社会规范”和“偏爱独处”。

sentences.en: In fact, Feist's research on both artists and scientists shows that one of the most prominent features of creative folks is their lesser interest in socialising.
sentences.zh: 事实上，费斯特对艺术家和科学家的研究表明，富有创造力的人最显著的特征之一就是对社交兴趣较低。

paragraphs.scanTag: 独处为艺术家提供创作所必需的反思与观察

sentences.en: One reason for this is that such people are likely to spend sustained time alone working on their craft.
sentences.zh: 原因之一在于，这类人往往会花持续的独处时间打磨技艺。

sentences.en: Plus, Feist says, many artists "are trying to make sense of their internal world and a lot of internal personal experiences that they're trying to give expression and meaning to through their art."
sentences.zh: 此外，费斯特说，许多艺术家“都在试图理清自己的内心世界及大量个人内在体验，并尝试通过艺术赋予其表达和意义”。

sentences.en: Solitude allows for the reflection and observation necessary for that creative process.
sentences.zh: 独处为这一创作过程提供了所必需的反思与观察。

paragraphs.scanTag: Julie Bowker 论文首次证实创造力特异地与“不爱社交（unsociability）”相关

sentences.en: A recent justification of these ideas came from University at Buffalo psychologist Julie Bowker, who researches social withdrawal.
sentences.zh: 纽约州立大学布法罗分校研究社交退缩的心理学家朱莉·鲍克最近为这些观点提供了佐证。

sentences.en: Social withdrawal is usually categorized into three types: shyness caused by fear or anxiety; avoidance, from a dislike of socialising; and unsociability, from a preference for solitude.
sentences.zh: 社交退缩通常分为三类：源于恐惧或焦虑的害羞；源于厌恶社交的回避；以及源于偏爱独处的不爱社交。

sentences.en: A paper by Bowker and her colleagues was the first to show that a type of social withdrawal could have a positive effect—they found that creativity was linked specifically to unsociability.
sentences.zh: 鲍克与同事的论文首次表明，某种社交退缩可能带来积极作用——他们发现创造力特异地与“不爱社交”相关联。

sentences.en: They also found that unsociability had no correlation with aggression (shyness and avoidance did). This was significant because while previous research had suggested that unsociability might be harmless, Bowker and colleagues' paper showed that it could actually be beneficial.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现不爱社交与攻击性无关（害羞和回避则有关）。这意义重大，因为此前研究仅认为不爱社交可能无害，而鲍克团队的论文证明它实际上是有益的。

sentences.en: Unsociable people are likely to be "having just enough interaction," Bowker says. "They have a preference for being alone, but they also don't mind being with others."
sentences.zh: 鲍克表示，不爱社交的人往往“恰好有足够的互动——他们偏爱独处，但也不介意与人相处”。

paragraphs.scanTag: 干扰段：内向型领导者在员工积极主动时反而更高效（披萨连锁店研究）

sentences.en: Still, it turns out that solitude is important for more than creativity. It's commonly believed that leaders need to be sociable. But this depends, among other things, on the personalities of their employees.
sentences.zh: 不过事实证明，独处的意义不止于创造力。人们普遍认为领导者必须善于社交，但这在很大程度上取决于员工的性格。

sentences.en: One 2011 study showed that in branches of a pizza chain where employees were more passive, outgoing bosses were associated with higher profits. But in branches where employees were more active, introverted (内向的) leaders were more effective. One reason for this is that introverted people are less likely to feel threatened by strong personalities and suggestions. They're also more likely to listen.
sentences.zh: 2011 年的一项研究表明，在员工较为被动的披萨连锁分店里，外向型老板能带来更高利润；但在员工更积极主动的分店里，内向型领导者更有效率。原因之一是内向者不易因强势性格和建议感到受威胁，也更善于倾听。

paragraphs.scanTag: 过渡段：自古隐士便知独处助专注；他人存在会分散大脑注意力

sentences.en: Since ancient times, meanwhile, people have been aware of a link between isolation and mental focus. After all, cultures with traditions of religious hermits (隐士) believe that solitude is important for enlightenment.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，自古以来人们就意识到独处与专注力之间的联系。毕竟，拥有宗教隐士传统的文化都相信独处对开悟至关重要。

sentences.en: Recent research has given us a better understanding of why. One benefit of unsociability is the brain's state of active mental rest, which goes hand-in-hand with the stillness of being alone. When another person is present, your brain can't help but pay some attention. This can be a positive distraction. But it's still a distraction.
sentences.zh: 近期研究让我们更清楚背后的原因。不爱社交的一大好处是大脑进入“积极心理休整”状态，这与独处的宁静相辅相成。有他人在场时，大脑难免会分心留意对方；哪怕这是积极的分心，归根结底仍是分心。

paragraphs.scanTag: 任思绪自由漫游（默认模式网络）从长远看反而提升专注力

sentences.en: Daydreaming in the absence of such distractions activates the brain's default-mode network. Among other functions, this network helps to consolidate memory and understand others' emotions.
sentences.zh: 在没有此类干扰的情况下做白日梦，会激活大脑的默认模式网络。除其他功能外，该网络有助于巩固记忆和理解他人情绪。

sentences.en: Giving free rein to a wandering mind not only helps with focus in the long term but strengthens your sense of both yourself and others.
sentences.zh: 任由思绪自由漫游，从长远来看不仅有助于提升专注力，还能增强你对自我与他人的认知。
anchors: Giving free rein to a wandering mind
helps with focus in the long term

sentences.en: Paradoxically, therefore, periods of solitude actually help when it comes time to socialise once more. And the occasional absence of focus ultimately helps concentration in the long run.
sentences.zh: 因此看似矛盾的是，独处时光实际上有助于你再次融入社交。而偶尔的走神，从长远来看最终能提升专注力。
anchors: helps concentration in the long run

paragraphs.scanTag: Susan Cain：要想走出自己的路，必须愿意至少独处一段时间

sentences.en: A more recent advocate of thoughtful and productive solitude is Susan Cain, author of Quiet: The Power of Introverts in a World That Can't Stop Talking and founder of Quiet Revolution, a company that promotes quiet and introvert-friendly workplaces.
sentences.zh: 近年来倡导深度且高效独处的代表人物是苏珊·凯恩，她是《安静：内向性格的竞争力》一书的作者，也是致力于推广安静且对内向者友好职场的“安静革命”公司创始人。

sentences.en: "These days, we tend to believe that creativity emerges from a decidedly unreservedly social process, but in fact it requires sustained attention and deep focus," she says.
sentences.zh: 她说：“如今我们往往以为创造力来自毫无保留的社交过程，但实际上它需要持续的注意力与深度专注。”

sentences.en: "Also, humans are such absorbent social beings that when we surround ourselves with others, we automatically take in their opinions and aesthetics. To truly chart our own path or vision, we have to be willing to isolate ourselves, at least for some period of time."
sentences.zh: “此外，人类是极易受周围影响的社会性动物，与人相伴时我们会不自觉地吸收他人的观点和审美。要想真正规划出自己的道路或愿景，我们必须愿意将自己隔绝出来，至少在一段时间内如此。”
anchors: at least for some period of time

paragraphs.scanTag: Feist 提醒：从不独处的人很难审视自我、了解自己

sentences.en: Still, the line between useful solitude and dangerous isolation can be blurry. "Almost anything can be adaptive and maladaptive, depending on how extreme they get," Feist says. A disorder has to do with dysfunction. If someone stops caring about people and cuts off all contact, this could point to an irrational neglect of social relations. But creative unsociability is a far cry from this.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，有益的独处与危险的孤立之间的界线有时很模糊。费斯特说：“几乎任何特质都可能既有适应性又有失调性，取决于极端程度。”障碍往往伴随着功能失调；如果一个人不再关心他人并切断一切联系，这可能意味着对社交关系的非理性忽视。但富有创造力的不爱社交与此截然不同。

sentences.en: In fact, Feist says, "there's a real danger with people who are never alone." It's hard to examine one's own thoughts, feelings and motives, to be self-aware, and fully relaxed unless you have occasional solitude.
sentences.zh: 事实上，费斯特说：“从不独处的人面临真正的危险。”除非你偶尔独处，否则很难审视自己的想法、感受和动机，也很难做到自我觉察和彻底放松。
anchors: hard to examine one's own thoughts

sentences.en: In addition, introverts tend to have fewer but stronger friendships—which has been linked to greater happiness.
sentences.zh: 此外，内向者往往拥有数量更少但更深厚的友谊——而这与更高的幸福感息息相关。

paragraphs.scanTag: 重质不重量：经营几段稳固关系胜过没完没了地闲聊社交

sentences.en: As with many things, quality reigns over quantity.
sentences.zh: 正如许多事情一样，质量胜过数量。

sentences.en: Nurturing a few solid relationships without feeling the need to constantly populate your life with endless chatting ultimately may be better for you.
sentences.zh: 用心经营几段稳固的关系，而不必觉得非要用没完没了的闲聊填满生活，最终可能对你更有益。

paragraphs.scanTag: 总结段：如果天性偏爱独处且有正常社交和几位好友，不必勉强改变

sentences.en: Thus, if your personality tends toward unsociability, you shouldn't feel the need to change. Of course, that comes with qualifications. But as long as you have regular social contact, you are choosing solitude rather than being forced into it, you have at least a few good friends and your solitude is good for your well-being or productivity, there's no point agonising over how to fit a square personality into a round hole.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你的性格偏向不爱社交，不必觉得非改不可。当然这有前提条件：只要你有规律的社交接触、独处是主动选择而非被迫、至少有几位好朋友，且独处有益于你的身心健康或工作效率，就没必要为如何把方形性格硬塞进圆形孔洞而苦恼。

readingA.title: Passage One · 职业焦虑与社会势利心态（46–50题）
readingA.sourceCitation: 出处：The School of Life ("How to Cope with Snobbery")
readingA.sourceLabel: The School of Life / Scribd 2025年6月第3套 Passage 1

sentences.en: Why are we so worried about our careers? Partly it's to do with money, but there's a psychological aspect to our fears as well.
sentences.zh: 我们为什么对自己的职业如此焦虑？部分原因与金钱有关，但我们的恐惧也有心理层面的根源。

sentences.en: {{HIT:46:hit-46:46A 正解依据:We worry because we suspect—not wrongly—that the world is full of a frightening sort of person ready to {{TRAP:46:trap-46-c:46C 挖坑:judge us ruthlessly and swiftly}}: a person we can call a snob.}}
sentences.zh: 我们焦虑，是因为我们不无道理地怀疑，这个世界上充斥着一种可怕的人，他们随时准备冷酷而草率地评判我们——我们可以称这种人为“势利眼”。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:47:trap-47-b:47B 挖坑:A snob is anyone who takes a relatively small part of us and uses it to come to a rigid conclusion about how much of their attention we deserve.}}
sentences.zh: 所谓势利眼，就是抓住我们身上微不足道的一小部分，并以此对我们值得获得多少关注得出僵化结论的人。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:47:trap-47-a:47A 挖坑:In the past, that might be your ancestry and royal connections.}}
sentences.zh: 在过去，这一小部分可能是你的家世血统和王室关系。

sentences.en: {{HIT:47:hit-47:47C 正解依据:Nowadays, the snob cares about one thing only: what you do for a living.}}
sentences.zh: 而如今，势利眼只在乎一件事：你以什么谋生（你的职业）。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:47:trap-47-d:47D 挖坑:This explains why the first question we will be asked in any new social context is 'What do you do?'}} and according to how we answer, snobs will either welcome us with broad smiles, or leave us in the cold.
sentences.zh: 这就解释了为什么在任何新的社交场合中，我们被问到的第一个问题总是“你是做什么的？”；而根据我们的回答，势利眼要么满脸堆笑地欢迎我们，要么把我们晾在一边。

sentences.en: And that is why we are fired up by such a desperate urge to achieve and impress.
sentences.zh: 也正因如此，我们内心才会燃起如此迫切的渴望，想要取得成就、令人刮目相看。

sentences.en: Sometimes our behavior is mistaken for greed and vanity, but it is more than this.
sentences.zh: 有时我们的行为会被误认为是贪婪和虚荣，但事实远不止如此。

sentences.en: A lot of our interest in fancy cars, jobs and houses has nothing to do with materialism.
sentences.zh: 我们对豪车、体面工作和豪宅的浓厚兴趣，很多时候与物质主义无关。

sentences.en: {{HIT:48:hit-48:48D 正解依据:It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods.}}
sentences.zh: 它源于对尊重与敬重的渴望——而在我们的社会里，这种尊重似乎只能通过获取物质财富才能换来。

sentences.en: It isn't the goods themselves we seek, it is the love we stand to gain through our possession of them.
sentences.zh: 我们追寻的不是物品本身，而是通过拥有这些物品可能换来的关爱。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:48:trap-48-ac:48A/C 挖坑:The next time we see someone driving a Ferrari, we shouldn't condemn them for their greed, we should pity them for the intensity of their need for love from the world.}}
sentences.zh: 下次看到有人开法拉利时，我们不该谴责他们贪婪，而该同情他们对世间关爱如此强烈的渴求。

sentence.tag: P4 长难句拆解 · 抽象名词+定语从句（Q48 定位）

chunks.text: It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem
that is only available in our societies
through the acquisition of material goods.

sentence.analysis: a hunger for the respect and esteem 精准对应 48D 中的 their craving for social recognition（craving = hunger，渴望）。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:49:trap-49-c:49C 挖坑:At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence about how to decide who in the world is valuable.}}
sentences.zh: 势利心态的根源在于缺乏想象力和自信，不知道该如何判断世上究竟谁才是有价值的人。

sentences.en: The snobs are brutally misguided and slavish in their beliefs about how the superior individuals can be identified.
sentences.zh: 在如何识别优秀人才这件事上，势利眼持有极其荒谬且盲从的信念。

sentences.en: {{HIT:49:hit-49:49A 正解依据:For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect.}}
sentences.zh: 对势利眼而言，只有那些已经声名显赫、功成名就的人，才配得上尊重。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:49:trap-49-bd:49B/D 挖坑:There is no room in their timid regimented minds to imagine that someone might be clever, kind or good—and yet somehow have been overlooked entirely by society, their qualities lying hidden beneath an unfamiliar veil, and having as yet discovered no obvious outlet.}}
sentences.zh: 在他们怯懦而僵化的头脑中，根本容不下这样的想象：一个人可能聪明、善良或优秀，却不知何故完全被社会忽视，其品质隐藏在陌生的面纱之下，尚未找到显眼的施展出口。

sentence.tag: P5 长难句拆解 · 强调句型 It is... who...（Q49 定位）

chunks.text: For snobs,
it is the already acclaimed and already successful
who are the only ones worthy of respect.

sentence.analysis: already acclaimed（已经享负盛名）对应 fame，already successful 对应 fortune，精准锁定 49A Those with fame and fortune。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:50:trap-50-acd:50A/C/D 挖坑:The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person, but to insist that better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places and carry none of the outward signs of distinction.}}
sentences.zh: 克服势利心态的真正答案，并不是说世上根本不存在高低优劣之分，而是要坚持认为：优秀与平庸总是出现在意想不到的地方，且往往不带任何外在的显赫标志。

sentences.en: {{HIT:50:hit-50:50B 正解依据:And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path.}}
sentences.zh: 正因为我们对他人的价值判断如此拙劣，我们最终的职责依然是对生命中遇到的几乎每一个人保持友善、善良、好奇与想象力。

readingB.title: Passage Two · 家庭休假政策与性别薪酬差距（51–55题）
readingB.sourceCitation: 出处：Quartz ("Closing the gender pay gap has stalled. A new study reveals why")

sentences.en: Women have historically been paid less.
sentences.zh: 历史上女性的薪酬一直较低。

sentences.en: {{HIT:51:hit-51:51B 正解依据:But in the US in the 1980s, they began to catch up—fast. During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year.}}
sentences.zh: 但在 20 世纪 80 年代的美国，她们开始迅速追赶。在那十年间，性别薪酬差距每年缩小约一个百分点。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:51:trap-51-cd:51C/D 挖坑:Had that trend continued, the gender wage gap would have been closed by 2017. But the trend didn't continue, and the gap remains yawning.}}
sentences.zh: 如果这一趋势得以延续，性别薪酬差距本应在 2017 年就已消除。但趋势未能持续，如今差距依然巨大。

sentences.en: According to a new study from academics at Harvard, the stagnation can be put down, perhaps counterintuitively, to the introduction of state and federal family leave policies.
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学学者的一项新研究表明，这一停滞或许有违直觉地可以归因于州和联邦家庭休假政策的推行。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:52:trap-52-c:52C 挖坑:The academics argue that during the 1990s, as governments began to introduce leave policies, it was mainly women who took advantage of them.}}
sentences.zh: 学者们认为，20 世纪 90 年代随着政府开始推行休假政策，主要使用这些政策的是女性。

sentences.en: Though the leave policies might have helped those women to stay in the workplace—instead of dropping out to have families—those who returned saw their wages had increased at lower rates than the men.
sentences.zh: 尽管休假政策可能帮助这些女性留在了职场——而不必为了组建家庭彻底离职——但重返职场的女性发现，她们的薪资增速低于男性。

sentences.en: {{HIT:52:hit-52:52B 正解依据:After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since.}}
sentences.zh: 事实上，美国推行家庭休假政策后，性别薪资趋同速度骤降至每年仅 0.03 个百分点，并且此后一直停留在这一水平。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:52:trap-52-a:52A 挖坑:Those monitoring the process towards salary equity at work have long watched as progress slowed in many countries around the world. In fact, that progress began to reverse during the pandemic (大流行病).}}
sentences.zh: 长期关注职场薪酬平等进程的人士早已看到全球许多国家的进展都在放缓。事实上，这一进程在疫情期间甚至开始倒退。

sentences.en: The gender pay gap is one of the most outstanding examples of that lack of parity (平等), and still exists just about everywhere.
sentences.zh: 性别薪酬差距是这种不平等最突出的例子之一，而且至今几乎无处不在。

sentences.en: The motherhood penalty has become a shorthand for describing why: In many places, especially rich countries, women earn the same as men until they reach their childbearing years. Women who have children begin to see their salaries slip behind their male counterparts.
sentences.zh: “母职惩罚”已成为解释其原因的简明说法：在许多地方尤其是富裕国家，女性在进入育龄期之前与男性同工同酬，但生育孩子后，她们的薪资便开始落后于男性同行。

sentences.en: {{HIT:53:hit-53:53C 正解依据:Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement.}}
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于女性承担了更多无偿家务劳动，这会侵占可用于工作的时间以及用于职业晋升的精力。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:53:trap-53-bd:53B/D 挖坑:But it's also because mothers are passed over for raises and promotion, and because time out of the workplace sets women back, even if that time is taken voluntarily and supported by company or government policy.}}
sentences.zh: 但另一部分原因在于母亲们在加薪和晋升时遭到忽视，而且离开职场的时间会让女性陷入劣势，即便这段休假是自愿的且得到了公司或政府政策的支持。

sentence.tag: P5 长难句拆解 · 原因从句+非限制性定语从句（Q53 定位）

chunks.text: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home,
which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement.

sentence.analysis: eat into 意为“侵占、消耗”，与 53C 的 huge amounts of time and energy women spend taking care of the family 严丝合缝。

sentences.en: What would have happened if leave policies hadn't been introduced?
sentences.zh: 如果当初没有推行休假政策，又会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: {{HIT:54:hit-54:54D 正解依据:The study doesn't go into that question, other than to say that if the 1980s trend continued, we would have been at parity by now.}}
sentences.zh: 这项研究并未深入探讨该问题，只是指出如果 20 世纪 80 年代的趋势得以延续，我们现在本已实现薪酬平等。

sentences.en: It's possible, however, that the journey towards wage parity would have stalled either way.
sentences.zh: 然而，无论如何，迈向薪酬平等的进程都有可能陷入停滞。

sentences.en: {{TRAP:55:trap-55-a:55A 挖坑:If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed,}} {{HIT:55:hit-55:55B 正解依据:there would still have been an issue with women—who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed, forcing them to take breaks, {{TRAP:55:trap-55-c:55C 挖坑:whether or not those breaks were mandated}}.}}
sentences.zh: 如果 80 年代女性的进步是通过消除偏见等问题实现的，那么一旦这些相对可控的问题得到解决，女性依然面临一道难题——由于哺乳能力等生理因素，承担生育及产后最初几周照料责任的是女性，这迫使她们不得不中断工作，无论这种休假是否由政策强制规定。

sentence.tag: P7 长难句拆解 · 多层条件+破折号定语从句（Q55 定位）

chunks.text: If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed,
there would still have been an issue with women—
who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed,
forcing them to take breaks, whether or not those breaks were mandated.

sentence.analysis: 全篇最难长难句！抓住破折号后直指本质的 bear children and take care of them，直接对应 55B Giving birth to children and taking care of them。

longReading.title: Yes, eating meat affects the environment, but cows are not killing the climate
longReading.titleZh: 是的，吃肉会影响环境，但奶牛并没有毁掉气候
longReading.wordCount: 约 1,240 词 · A–O 共 15 段
longReading.sourceNote: 2025年6月六级第3套 Section B（原文改编自 The Conversation / UC Davis CLEAR Center，经 Scribd 原卷与说客英语交叉核验）

paragraphs.scanTag: 环保倡导者呼吁少吃肉甚至对肉类征税以应对气候变化

sentences.en: As the scale and impacts of climate change become increasingly alarming, meat is a popular target for action.
sentences.zh: 随着气候变化的规模和影响日益令人担忧，肉类成了人们采取行动的热门目标。

sentences.en: Advocates for the protection of the natural environment from destruction or pollution urge the public to eat less meat.
sentences.zh: 呼吁保护自然环境免遭破坏或污染的倡导者们敦促公众少吃肉。
anchors: urge the public to eat less meat

sentences.en: Some activists have even called for taxing meat to reduce consumption of it.
sentences.zh: 一些活动人士甚至呼吁对肉类征税以减少其消费。

paragraphs.scanTag: 立论段：反驳“肉类生产排放高于整个交通业”这一错误说法

sentences.en: A key claim underlying these arguments holds that globally, meat production generates more greenhouse gases than the entire transportation sector.
sentences.zh: 支撑这些论点的一个核心说法认为，从全球来看，肉类生产产生的温室气体超过了整个交通运输部门。

sentences.en: However, this claim is demonstrably wrong, as I will show. And its persistence has led to false assumptions about the linkage between meat and climate change.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如我将证明的那样，这一说法明显是错误的。它的持续流传导致人们对肉类与气候变化之间的联系产生了错误假设。

paragraphs.scanTag: 作者观点：放弃肉类并非解决环境问题的万灵药（panacea）

sentences.en: My recent research focuses on ways in which animal agriculture affects air quality and climate change. In my view, there are many reasons for either choosing animal protein or opting for a vegetarian selection.
sentences.zh: 我近期的研究聚焦于畜牧业对空气质量和气候变化的影响。在我看来，无论是选择动物蛋白还是选择素食，都有很多理由。

sentences.en: However, abandoning meat and meat products is not the environmental panacea (万灵药) many would have us believe. And if taken to an extreme, it also could have harmful nutritional consequences.
sentences.zh: 然而，放弃肉类及肉制品并不是许多人想让我们相信的那种环境万灵药。如果走向极端，它还可能带来有害的营养后果。

paragraphs.scanTag: 肉类背负恶名源于“畜牧业是全球最大温室气体来源”的论断

sentences.en: A healthy portion of meat's negative reputation centers on the assertion that livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases worldwide.
sentences.zh: 肉类负面名声的很大一部分，源于“牲畜是全球最大温室气体来源”这一论断。
anchors: livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases

sentences.en: For example, an analysis published in 2009 by the World Watch Institute based in Washington, D.C. asserted that 51 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions come from rearing and processing livestock.
sentences.zh: 例如，总部位于华盛顿特区的世界观察研究所 2009 年发布的一份分析声称，全球 51% 的温室气体排放来自牲畜饲养和加工。

sentences.en: According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the largest sources of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions in 2016 were electricity production (28 percent of total emissions), transportation (28 percent) and industry (22 percent). All of agriculture accounted for a total of 9 percent, but all of animal agriculture contributes less than half of this amount, representing 3.9 percent of the total greenhouse emission in the U.S. That is very different from claiming that livestock represents as much as or more than transportation.
sentences.zh: 根据美国环保署数据，2016 年美国最大的温室气体排放源是发电（28%）、交通（28%）和工业（22%）。整个农业共占 9%，而所有畜牧业占比不足其中一半，仅占美国总排放的 3.9%。这与声称畜牧业排放不亚于甚至超过交通业的说法大相径庭。

paragraphs.scanTag: FAO 2006年报告得出惊人结论：畜牧业比所有交通方式总和更害气候

sentences.en: Why is there such a misconception? In 2006 the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) published a study titled "Livestock's Long Shadow," which received widespread international attention.
sentences.zh: 为什么会有这种误解？2006 年，联合国粮农组织（FAO）发表了一项题为《牲畜的巨大阴影》的研究，引起了广泛国际关注。

sentences.en: It stated that livestock produced a staggering 18 percent of the world's greenhouse gas emissions. The agency drew a startling conclusion that livestock was doing more to harm the climate than all modes of transportation combined.
sentences.zh: 报告称，牲畜产生了惊人的全球 18% 的温室气体排放。该机构得出一个令人震惊的结论：牲畜对气候的危害超过所有交通方式的总和。

sentences.en: This latter claim was wrong, and has since been corrected by Henning Stenfeld, the report's senior author.
sentences.zh: 后一说法是错误的，此后已由该报告的高级作者亨宁·斯滕菲尔德予以纠正。

paragraphs.scanTag: 干扰段：剖析 FAO 统计口径偏差（对畜牧业用了全生命周期评估）

sentences.en: The problem was that analysts from the FAO used a comprehensive life-cycle assessment to study the climate impact of livestock, but a different method when they analyzed transportation.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，FAO 的分析人员对畜牧业的气候影响采用了全面的生命周期评估，而在分析交通业时却用了不同的方法。

sentences.en: For livestock, they considered every factor associated with producing meat. This included emissions from fertilizer production, converting land from forests to pastures, growing feed, and direct emissions from animals (manure as well as expelling of gas from the stomach) from birth to death.
sentences.zh: 对于畜牧业，他们考量了与产肉相关的每一个环节，包括化肥生产、毁林开牧、种植饲料以及动物从出生到死亡的直接排放（粪便与胃部排气）。

paragraphs.scanTag: 干扰段：剖析交通业只算了尾气排放，导致对比严重失真

sentences.en: However, when they looked at transportation's carbon footprint, they ignored impacts on the climate from manufacturing vehicle materials and parts, assembling vehicles and maintaining roads, bridges and airports.
sentences.zh: 然而，在考察交通业的碳足迹时，他们却忽略了制造车辆材料零件、组装车辆以及维护道路桥梁机场对气候的影响。

sentences.en: Instead, they only considered the exhaust smoke emitted by finished cars, trucks, trains and planes. As a result, the FAO's comparison of greenhouse gas emissions from livestock to those from transportation was greatly distorted.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们只计算了成品汽车、卡车、火车和飞机排出的尾气。结果，FAO 对畜牧业与交通业温室气体排放的对比被严重扭曲了。

paragraphs.scanTag: 值得称赞的是（To its credit），漏洞被指出后 FAO 立即承认了错误

sentences.en: I pointed out this flaw during a speech to fellow scientists in San Francisco on March 22, 2010, which led to a flood of media coverage.
sentences.zh: 我在 2010 年 3 月 22 日旧金山面向同行科学家的演讲中指出了这一漏洞，引发了媒体铺天盖地的报道。

sentences.en: To its credit, the FAO immediately owned up to its error.
sentences.zh: 值得肯定的是，FAO 立即坦承了自己的错误。
anchors: immediately owned up to its error

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the agency's initial claim that livestock was responsible for the lion's share of world greenhouse gas emissions had already received wide coverage. To this day, we struggle to "unring" the bell. In its most recent assessment report, the FAO estimated that livestock produces 14.5 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions from human activities. There is no comparable full life-cycle assessment for transportation. However, as Stenfeld has pointed out, direct emissions from transportation versus livestock can be compared and amount to 14 versus 5 percent, respectively.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，该机构最初称牲畜占全球温室气体排放大头的说法早已广为传播，至今覆水难收。在最新评估报告中，FAO 估计牲畜占人类活动全球温室气体排放的 14.5%。交通业目前没有可比的全生命周期评估；不过正如斯滕菲尔德指出的，两者直接排放可以对比，交通业和畜牧业分别占 14% 和 5%。

paragraphs.scanTag: 近期研究：即便美国人完全戒除动物蛋白，全美减排也仅 2.6%

sentences.en: Many people continue to think that avoiding meat as infrequently as once a week will make a significant difference to the climate.
sentences.zh: 许多人仍然认为，哪怕一周只有一天不吃肉，也能对气候产生重大影响。

sentences.en: But according to one recent study, even if Americans eliminated all animal protein from their diets, they would reduce U.S. greenhouse gas emissions by only 2.6 percent.
sentences.zh: 但根据最近的一项研究，即便美国人从饮食中彻底剔除所有动物蛋白，也只会使美国温室气体排放减少区区 2.6%。
anchors: even if Americans eliminated all animal protein

sentences.en: According to our research at the University of California, Davis, if the practice of Meatless Monday were to be adopted by all Americans, we'd see a reduction of only 0.5 percent.
sentences.zh: 根据我们在加州大学戴维斯分校的研究，如果全体美国人都实行“无肉星期一”，减排幅度也仅有 0.5%。

paragraphs.scanTag: 过去70年美国农业技术、育种与管理变革大幅提效减排（产量翻倍、排放降11.3%）

sentences.en: Moreover, technological, genetic and management changes that have taken place in U.S. agriculture over the past 70 years have made livestock production more efficient and less greenhouse gas-intensive.
sentences.zh: 此外，过去 70 年美国农业在技术、基因育种和管理方面的变革，使畜牧生产更加高效且温室气体排放强度更低。

sentences.en: According to the FAO's statistical database, total direct greenhouse gas emissions from U.S. livestock have declined by 11.3 percent since 1961, while production of livestock meat has more than doubled.
sentences.zh: 根据 FAO 统计数据库，自 1961 年以来，美国牲畜的直接温室气体总排放量下降了 11.3%，而畜肉产量却增长了一倍以上。

paragraphs.scanTag: 发展中国家人均肉类消费远低于发达国家（18/24公斤 vs 92公斤）

sentences.en: Demand for meat is rising in developing and emerging economies, especially in the Middle East, North Africa and Southeast Asia. For example, raising livestock such as goats in Kenya is an important source of food and income for many small-scale farmers and herders.
sentences.zh: 发展中及新兴经济体对肉类的需求正在上升，尤其是中东、北非和东南亚地区。例如在肯尼亚饲养山羊等牲畜是许多小农户和牧民的重要食物和收入来源。

sentences.en: But meat consumption per person in these regions still lags that of developed countries. In 2015, average annual meat consumption per person in developed countries was 92 kilograms, compared to 24 kilograms in the Middle East and North Africa and 18 kilograms in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 但这些地区的人均肉类消费量仍远落后于发达国家。2015 年发达国家人均年肉类消费为 92 公斤，而中东和北非为 24 公斤，东南亚仅为 18 公斤。

sentences.en: Still, given projected population growth in the developing world, there will certainly be an opportunity for countries such as the United States to bring their sustainable livestock rearing practices to the table.
sentences.zh: 不过鉴于发展中国家预期的人口增长，像美国这样的国家无疑有机会分享其可持续畜牧养殖经验。

paragraphs.scanTag: 去除畜牧业会使满足人类营养需求变得更加困难

sentences.en: Removing animals from U.S. agriculture would lower national greenhouse gas emissions to a small degree, but it would also make it harder to meet people's nutritional requirements.
sentences.zh: 从美国农业中去除畜牧业虽能在很小程度上降低全国温室气体排放，但也会使满足人们的营养需求变得更加困难。
anchors: harder to meet people's nutritional requirements

sentences.en: Many critics of animal agriculture are quick to point out that if farmers raised only plants, they could produce more pounds of food and more calories per person. But humans also need many essential micro- and macro-nutrients for good health. It's hard to make a compelling argument that the United States has a calorie deficit, given its high national rates of adult and child obesity. Moreover, not all plant parts are edible or desirable. Raising livestock is a way to add nutritional and economic value to plant agriculture.
sentences.zh: 许多畜牧业批评者很快指出，如果农民只种植物，人均能生产更多食物和热量。但人类健康还需要多种必需的微量和宏量营养素；鉴于美国成人和儿童肥胖率居高不下，很难说美国存在热量赤字。此外，并非植物所有部分都可食用，饲养牲畜正是为种植业增加营养和经济价值的方式。

paragraphs.scanTag: 全球高达 70% 的农业用地仅适合反刍牲畜放牧

sentences.en: As one example, the energy in plants that livestock consume is most often contained in cellulose (纤维素), which is indigestible for humans and many other mammals. But cows, sheep and other ruminant (反刍的) animals can break cellulose down and release the solar energy contained in this vast resource.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，牲畜食用的植物能量大多蕴含在纤维素中，而人类及许多其他哺乳动物无法消化纤维素。但牛、羊和其他反刍动物能分解纤维素，释放这一庞大资源中蕴含的太阳能。

sentences.en: According to the FAO, as much as 70 percent of all agricultural land globally is range land that can only be utilized as grazing land for ruminant livestock.
sentences.zh: 据 FAO 统计，全球高达 70% 的农业用地是牧场，只能用作反刍牲畜的放牧草地。
anchors: only be utilized as grazing land

paragraphs.scanTag: 干扰段：2050年全球人口达98亿，肉类热量密度高且为10亿人提供生计

sentences.en: The world population is currently projected to reach 9.8 billion by 2050. Feeding this many people will raise immense challenges. Meat is more calorie-dense per serving than vegetarian options, and ruminant animals largely thrive on feed that is not suitable for humans. Raising livestock also offers much-needed income for small-scale farmers in developing nations. Worldwide, livestock provides a livelihood for 1 billion people.
sentences.zh: 目前预计到 2050 年世界人口将达 98 亿，养活这么多人将带来巨大挑战。每份肉类的热量密度高于素食，且反刍动物主要依靠不适合人类食用的饲料生长。饲养牲畜还为发展中国家小农户提供急需的收入，全球有 10 亿人依靠畜牧业维持生计。

paragraphs.scanTag: 总结段：以科学事实为起点，持续提升畜牧业效率

sentences.en: Climate change demands urgent attention, and the livestock industry has a large overall environmental footprint that affects air, water and land. These, combined with a rapidly rising world population, give us plenty of compelling reasons to continue to work for greater efficiencies in animal agriculture. I believe the place to start is with science-based facts.
sentences.zh: 气候变化亟需关注，畜牧业也确实对空气、水和土地有着较大的总体环境足迹。这些因素加上迅速增长的世界人口，给了我们充分理由继续提高畜牧业效率。我相信，一切应从基于科学的事实出发。

questions.stem: The FAO concluded that farm animals were producing more greenhouse gases than all modes of transportation combined.
questions.stemZh: 联合国粮农组织得出结论称，农场动物产生的温室气体超过了所有交通方式的总和。

keywords.note: 一级专有名词：E 段 The agency (FAO) drew a startling conclusion
一级原词长短语复现！

questions.scanPath: 一眼锁死超长原词短语 all modes of transportation combined + FAO，直接撞进 E 段第 3 句 The agency drew a startling conclusion that livestock was doing more to harm the climate than all modes of transportation combined，5 秒秒杀 E！
questions.evidenceQuote: In 2006 the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) published a study... The agency drew a startling conclusion that livestock was doing more to harm the climate than all modes of transportation combined.

paraphrases.note: 高频同义词：farm animals = livestock（牲畜）
词性转换

distractorTrap.reason: B、D 段也提到了 livestock 与 transportation 对比，但未提及 FAO 得出该结论。

questions.stem: Consumption of meat per person in developing countries is much less than that in countries like the U.S.
questions.stemZh: 发展中国家的人均肉类消费量远低于美国等发达国家。

keywords.note: 一级精准短语：K 段 meat consumption per person
二级核心：lags that of developed countries (18/24 kg vs 92 kg)

questions.scanPath: 直扫 developing + meat consumption per person：K 段首句 developing and emerging economies，第 3 句直接命中 meat consumption per person in these regions still lags that of developed countries，稳锁 K！
questions.evidenceQuote: Demand for meat is rising in developing and emerging economies... But meat consumption per person in these regions still lags that of developed countries. In 2015, average annual meat consumption per person in developed countries was 92 kilograms, compared to 24 kilograms... and 18 kilograms...

paraphrases.p: still lags (92 kg vs 24 kg / 18 kg)
paraphrases.note: 动词+数据印证：lag = 落后于/远低于

paraphrases.p: developed countries (countries such as the United States)
paraphrases.note: 上下义替换

distractorTrap.reason: N 段也提到了 developing nations，但说的是畜牧业为小农户提供收入，未提人均肉类消费对比。

questions.stem: The FAO was worthy of praise in that it admitted its mistake once it was pointed out.
questions.stemZh: 联合国粮农组织值得称赞，因为错误一经指出它便予以承认。

keywords.note: 二级高频习语替换：H 段 To its credit（值得肯定/赞扬）

keywords.text: admitted its mistake once it was pointed out
keywords.note: 二级核心：pointed out this flaw + immediately owned up to its error

questions.scanPath: 扫 FAO + pointed out / error：E/F/G/H 都有 FAO，但只有 H 段首两句出现 I pointed out this flaw... To its credit, the FAO immediately owned up to its error，精准锁定 H！
questions.evidenceQuote: I pointed out this flaw during a speech to fellow scientists in San Francisco on March 22, 2010... To its credit, the FAO immediately owned up to its error.

paraphrases.note: 六级超高频习语：to one's credit = 值得赞扬

paraphrases.q: admitted its mistake once it was pointed out
paraphrases.p: pointed out this flaw ... immediately owned up to its error
paraphrases.note: 动词短语替换：own up to = admit（坦白承认）

distractorTrap.reason: E 段末句提到了报告作者后来纠正了说法（corrected），但没有“值得称赞（To its credit）”和“被指出后立即承认”。

questions.stem: Environmentalists try hard to make people consume less meat to combat climate change.
questions.stemZh: 环保主义者竭力劝说人们少吃肉以应对气候变化。

keywords.note: 二级核心：A 段 Advocates for the protection of the natural environment

keywords.text: consume less meat / combat climate change
keywords.note: 二级核心：urge the public to eat less meat / climate change

questions.scanPath: 扫 eat less meat / climate change：A 段开门见山 climate change → Advocates for the protection of the natural environment... urge the public to eat less meat，10 秒锁 A！
questions.evidenceQuote: As the scale and impacts of climate change become increasingly alarming, meat is a popular target for action. Advocates for the protection of the natural environment from destruction or pollution urge the public to eat less meat.

paraphrases.p: Advocates for the protection of the natural environment
paraphrases.note: 释义压缩：自然环境保护倡导者 = 环保主义者

paraphrases.q: try hard to make people consume less meat
paraphrases.p: urge the public to eat less meat
paraphrases.note: 动词替换：urge = 极力敦促

distractorTrap.reason: I 段说许多普通人以为每周一天不吃肉很有用，主体不是“环保主义者呼吁大家少吃肉”。

questions.stem: Recent research has shown that even if Americans quit eating meat altogether, the resulting reduction of greenhouse gases in the U.S. would be slight.
questions.stemZh: 近期研究表明，即便美国人完全戒吃肉，由此带来的美国温室气体减排幅度也微乎其微。

keywords.text: even if Americans quit eating meat altogether
keywords.note: 一级精准句式：I 段 even if Americans eliminated all animal protein from their diets
二级核心：reduce ... by only 2.6 percent

questions.scanPath: 直扫 Americans + even if：I 段第 2 句原句框架重现 according to one recent study, even if Americans eliminated all animal protein from their diets, they would reduce U.S. greenhouse gas emissions by only 2.6 percent，秒杀 I！
questions.evidenceQuote: But according to one recent study, even if Americans eliminated all animal protein from their diets, they would reduce U.S. greenhouse gas emissions by only 2.6 percent.

paraphrases.p: eliminated all animal protein from their diets
paraphrases.note: 同义替换：quit altogether = eliminate all
数据定性：仅 2.6% = 微乎其微（slight）

distractorTrap.reason: L 段首句也提到去除美国畜牧业只能小幅降排，但没有“近期研究（recent study）”和“美国人饮食戒肉（Americans）”。

questions.stem: More than half of the world's farmland is suitable only for animals like cows to graze on.
questions.stemZh: 全球一半以上的农田只适合供牛之类的动物放牧。

keywords.note: 一级数字换算：M 段 as much as 70 percent（70% > 50%！）

keywords.text: farmland ... suitable only for ... graze on
keywords.note: 一级精准词：agricultural land globally ... only be utilized as grazing land

questions.scanPath: 直扫 graze / agricultural land / 百分比：M 段尾句直接出现 as much as 70 percent of all agricultural land globally is range land that can only be utilized as grazing land for ruminant livestock，70% 对应 More than half，稳锁 M！
questions.evidenceQuote: But cows, sheep and other ruminant animals... According to the FAO, as much as 70 percent of all agricultural land globally is range land that can only be utilized as grazing land for ruminant livestock.

paraphrases.note: 经典数字换算：70% = 超过一半

paraphrases.q: farmland ... suitable only for ... graze on
paraphrases.p: agricultural land ... only be utilized as grazing land
paraphrases.note: 原词词根对应：graze → grazing land

distractorTrap.reason: D 段也有 51 percent（超过一半），但那是 2009 年某报告声称的畜牧业排放占比，不是农田放牧比例。

questions.stem: The allegation that farm animals produce the world's largest portion of greenhouse gases is responsible for meat's bad reputation.
questions.stemZh: 声称农场动物产生全球最大比例温室气体的说法，是肉类背负恶名的原因。

keywords.note: 一级精准短语：D 段首句 meat's negative reputation

keywords.text: allegation ... largest portion of greenhouse gases
keywords.note: 二级核心：assertion that livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases worldwide

questions.scanPath: 直扫 reputation！全篇仅 D 段首句出现 meat's negative reputation centers on the assertion that livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases worldwide，5 秒锁定 D！
questions.evidenceQuote: A healthy portion of meat's negative reputation centers on the assertion that livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases worldwide.

paraphrases.note: 高阶词替换：allegation（未经证实的声称）= assertion（论断）
直接替换

distractorTrap.reason: H 段有 lion's share（最大份额），但没有提到 meat's negative reputation（肉类的坏名声）。

questions.stem: Raising farm animals makes it easier to meet people's nutritional needs.
questions.stemZh: 饲养农场动物使满足人们的营养需求变得更加容易。

keywords.note: 一级精准短语：L 段首句 meet people's nutritional requirements

keywords.text: Raising farm animals makes it easier
keywords.note: 二级正反转换：Removing animals ... would make it harder（去掉更难 = 饲养更容易！）

questions.scanPath: 扫 nutritional：C 段也有 nutritional consequences，但讲的是极端戒肉的危害；往下扫到 L 段首句原词命中 Removing animals... would also make it harder to meet people's nutritional requirements（反说正推：去掉更难 = 保留饲养更容易），锁定 L！
questions.evidenceQuote: Removing animals from U.S. agriculture would lower national greenhouse gas emissions to a small degree, but it would also make it harder to meet people's nutritional requirements. ... Raising livestock is a way to add nutritional and economic value to plant agriculture.

paraphrases.q: Raising farm animals makes it easier
paraphrases.p: Removing animals ... would make it harder
paraphrases.note: 经典正话反说：去掉更难 ↔ 饲养更容易
高频替换：needs = requirements

distractorTrap.reason: C 段提了 harmful nutritional consequences，N 段提了 calorie-dense，但只有 L 段完整对应“满足营养需求（meet people's nutritional requirements）”。

questions.stem: The author doesn't believe giving up meat and meat products will be a cure-all for the environmental problem.
questions.stemZh: 作者不认为放弃肉类和肉制品会成为解决环境问题的万能药。

keywords.text: giving up meat and meat products
keywords.note: 一级精准短语：C 段 abandoning meat and meat products
一级罕见词替换：C 段 environmental panacea (万灵药)！

questions.scanPath: 扫 meat and meat products / panacea (万灵药)：C 段第 3 句直接出现 abandoning meat and meat products is not the environmental panacea (万灵药) many would have us believe，精准秒杀 C！
questions.evidenceQuote: However, abandoning meat and meat products is not the environmental panacea (万灵药) many would have us believe.

paraphrases.note: 高频替换：give up = abandon
生词带中文注释直接对应：cure-all = 万灵药

distractorTrap.reason: B 段反驳的是“肉类排放超过交通业”，C 段才给出作者“弃肉不是万灵药”的核心观点。

questions.stem: Changes in America's farming technology and management in the past decades have increased efficiency and reduced greenhouse gas emissions in meat production.
questions.stemZh: 过去几十年美国农业技术和管理的变革提高了肉类生产效率并减少了温室气体排放。

keywords.text: farming technology and management / past decades
keywords.note: 一级精准短语：J 段 technological, genetic and management changes ... U.S. agriculture over the past 70 years

keywords.text: increased efficiency and reduced greenhouse gas emissions
keywords.note: 二级核心：more efficient and less greenhouse gas-intensive / declined by 11.3 percent

questions.scanPath: 扫 technology / management / past 70 years：J 段首句原封不动命中 technological, genetic and management changes ... in U.S. agriculture over the past 70 years have made livestock production more efficient and less greenhouse gas-intensive，直接锁 J！
questions.evidenceQuote: Moreover, technological, genetic and management changes that have taken place in U.S. agriculture over the past 70 years have made livestock production more efficient and less greenhouse gas-intensive. ... total direct greenhouse gas emissions from U.S. livestock have declined by 11.3 percent since 1961...

paraphrases.note: 时间概括：过去70年 = 过去几十年

paraphrases.q: increased efficiency and reduced greenhouse gas emissions
paraphrases.p: more efficient and less greenhouse gas-intensive / declined by 11.3 percent
paraphrases.note: 因果对应

distractorTrap.reason: O 段呼吁未来继续追求更高效率（continue to work for greater efficiencies），而 J 段总结的是过去 70 年已经取得的提效减排成果。
